- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FULL-OSCILLATOR-BOUNDED-DOUBLET-SELECTOR-YAROTSKY-SINGLE-PHASE-TRANSFER](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-full-oscillator-bounded-doublet-selector-yarotsky-single-phase-transfer), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIXED-FINITE-FULL-HAMILTONIAN-BOUNDED-LOCAL-STRICT-C0-AND-MAXIMAL-CONTINUOUS-ELEMENT-KMS-CORE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-fixed-finite-full-hamiltonian-bounded-local-strict-c0-and-maximal-continuous-element-kms-core), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-FINITE-ZERO-SOURCE-UNIFORM-CONTINUOUS-ELEMENT-PRODUCT-ENVELOPE-AND-FIXED-BETA-KMS-COMPACTNESS](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-finite-zero-source-uniform-continuous-element-product-envelope-and-fixed-beta-kms-compactness), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIXED-BETA-OS-MIXTURE-MAXIMAL-CONTINUOUS-ELEMENT-DISTINCT-PHASE-KMS-CORE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-fixed-beta-os-mixture-maximal-continuous-element-distinct-phase-kms-core), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-CONNECTED-RANK-TWO-OSCILLATOR-ELIMINATION-QPS-NORM-AND-CUTOFF-COMPATIBILITY](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-connected-rank-two-oscillator-elimination-qps-norm-and-cutoff-compatibility), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-INFINITE-DIMENSIONAL-RANK-TWO-BAND-BLOCK-DIAGONALIZATION-AND-TWO-PHASE-QPS](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-infinite-dimensional-rank-two-band-block-diagonalization-and-two-phase-qps), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-BROKEN-SECTOR-GNS-GAP-COERCIVITY](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-broken-sector-gns-gap-coercivity), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Can the registered large-N relative-form control reach an exact full-oscillator selected phase, and which maximal norm-continuous and KMS carriers can be proved without claiming the missing all-shape common alpha?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Group the three positive cubic edges into one forward star, compute its exact three-label spectrum after adding the bounded doublet selector, normalize the inherited relative-form bounds by the exact star gap, and apply Yarotsky Theorem 1. (2) Identify the continuous part of each exact finite-volume inner action, its temporal-smear generator core and energy topology, then take the maximal uniformly continuous subalgebra of the product over all finite shapes. (3) Restrict the previously reconstructed fixed-beta OS-mixture action to its maximal norm-continuous part and verify that temporal smearing preserves the distinct KMS phase witness. (4) Audit selector removal, N-dependent two-phase-radius entry and categorical exhaustion convergence with exact forward-star, scalar-sequence and alternating-M2 fixtures.
- **Finding:** For every fixed 0<u<=1 and sufficiently large N, adding the bounded spectral-doublet selector to the exact full-oscillator Q3 Hamiltonian gives a Yarotsky single-phase theorem: a nondegenerate finite-volume ground vector, a positive gap independent of periodic volume for that fixed admissible model, a thermodynamic weak-star ground-state limit and exponential clustering. Separately, each finite exact Hamiltonian has its maximal norm-C0 continuous part; the product over all finite shapes has a maximal uniform continuous-element envelope with fixed-beta KMS cluster points; and the fixed-beta OS mixture has a weak-star dense maximal continuous part carrying the two distinct KMS restrictions. Selector add-subtract has relative ratio one, vanishing defects need not enter N-dependent two-phase radii, and the categorical envelope does not imply all-shape Cauchy convergence or a unique phase quotient.
- **Decision reason:** The exact forward-star gap is g_(star,N)(u)=min{u,2J_N+u/6,Gamma_N/6+J_N}=u for the declared sufficiently-large-N range, while the normalized perturbation pair is (alpha_N,3beta_N/u) and tends into the single-phase theorem region. The continuous-part constructions are canonical consequences of the given actions, and the exact hostile fixtures delimit precisely what those constructions do not supply.
- **Boundary:** This is T0 and claim_bearing:false. The oscillator theorem uses an artificial bounded spectral-doublet selector rather than the physical linear source and proves no selector removal, zero-source coexistence, common two-phase radius or broken-sector GNS Hamiltonian gap. The continuous-element results are finite-volume, categorical product, or fixed-beta OS-mixture statements; they prove no spatial net, all-shape exhaustion Cauchy identification, unique phase quotient, beta-independent thermodynamic alpha, Round-1, C6, CP1, physical Sector A or Pre-A closure. No v2.9 PDF is issued.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Quantitatively compare the zero-source oscillator defect with a common positive two-phase QPS radius, and independently construct compatible spatial embeddings with two-sign all-shape Cauchy control and phase quotient identification. Keep the broken-sector GNS and prospective Round-1 programmes separate.

- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LINFINITY-CONFIGURATION-MULTIPLIER-ESSENTIAL-RANGE-FULL-HAMILTONIAN-NORM-JUMP-AND-JOINT-STANDARD-CYLINDER-SCALARITY](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-linfinity-configuration-multiplier-essential-range-full-hamiltonian-norm-jump-and-joint-standard-cylinder-scalarity), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-CONNECTED-RANK-TWO-OSCILLATOR-ELIMINATION-QPS-NORM-AND-CUTOFF-COMPATIBILITY](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-connected-rank-two-oscillator-elimination-qps-norm-and-cutoff-compatibility), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-INFINITE-DIMENSIONAL-RANK-TWO-BAND-BLOCK-DIAGONALIZATION-AND-TWO-PHASE-QPS](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-infinite-dimensional-rank-two-band-block-diagonalization-and-two-phase-qps), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-BROKEN-SECTOR-GNS-GAP-COERCIVITY](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-broken-sector-gns-gap-coercivity), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Can the exact finite-volume Q3 full-Hamiltonian multiplier obstruction be extended from continuous configuration functions to all bounded measurable multipliers, and what does that imply for the canonical one-site cylinder when combined with the isolated-bond modulation classification?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Choose Lebesgue points in two positive-measure essential-range level sets, boost a fixed-width compactly supported smooth packet by p_t=chi(y-x)/t, and use the exact Galilean density translation for both signs of t. (2) Bound the interaction/free expectation difference by polynomial Duhamel control along the compact segment from x to y, preserving the fixed-epsilon-before-t and t-before-epsilon limit order. (3) Use scalar midpoint subtraction for real multipliers, then intersect the resulting full-Hamiltonian continuous multipliers with the v3.0 isolated-bond multiplication-MASA classification. (4) Derive independent real-step, complex-step, signed Galilean, quartic-translation and joint-cylinder fixtures and audit the remaining dressed-shell route against the exact Q3 hypotheses.
- **Finding:** For every bounded measurable configuration multiplier M_f in one fixed finite Q3 volume, the nonzero-time small-time norm liminf under the exact full Hamiltonian is at least the diameter of the essential range of f; for real f the exact limit is its essential oscillation. Consequently, inside the canonical standard one-site cylinder, simultaneous point-norm continuity for one isolated bilinear bond flow and the exact full-Hamiltonian flow leaves only scalars. This strictly strengthens the prior bounded-continuous and raw-Weyl multiplier boundaries.
- **Decision reason:** Lebesgue differentiation supplies representative packet centres, Galilean density transport fixes the macroscopic displacement for both time signs, and the polynomial interaction contributes only an O(|t|) expectation error at each fixed packet width. The v3.0 bond theorem then forces every bond-continuous canonical cylinder to be a multiplier, so the new full-Hamiltonian result makes the joint intersection scalar.
- **Boundary:** This is T0 and claim_bearing:false. It is a fixed-finite-volume multiplier theorem and a classification only inside the raw canonical standard one-site cylinder. It does not classify either full continuous-element algebra, prove common-alpha nonexistence, or exclude multi-site compact, temporal-smear, resolvent-smoothed, interaction-dressed, local-strict, strong-star or state-weighted carriers. It proves no exact-Q3 dressed shell weights, full-oscillator two-phase transfer, target-generator convergence, broken-sector GNS gap, Round-1, C6, CP1, physical Sector A or Pre-A closure. No v3.1 PDF is issued.

- **Question:** Under which common-algebra, common-generator and fixed-separator hypotheses do beta-to-infinity phase-labelled KMS sequences yield two distinct algebraic ground states, and can finite norm-separated extremal KMS pairs still collapse without one fixed witness?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Apply the differential KMS inequality in the physical-time convention and use the extended entropy bound s(x,y)>=-y to obtain a universal energy-form lower bound of order minus one over beta. (2) Pass KMS invariance and the energy form through weak-star state convergence and norm convergence of both phase generators on one common graph core, then extend by graph closure to the full target-generator domain. (3) Pass the parity generator intertwining through graph closure and closed-generator uniqueness, then use one fixed bounded odd contraction with a uniform sign to separate the two target ground states. (4) Test the fixed-witness premise on the exact trivial-dynamics C([-1,1]) family of parity-related evaluation states at plus and minus one over n.
- **Finding:** For two phase-labelled beta_n-KMS state sequences on one identified unital C-star algebra, beta_n tending to infinity, weak-star state convergence and norm convergence of both generators on one graph core to one common target generator imply that both limit states are algebraic ground states of the same target dynamics. If a fixed bounded parity-odd contraction retains a uniform positive sign, the limits are parity related and their state-norm distance is bounded below by twice that sign. Conversely, pure, extremal, factorial, parity-related finite KMS pairs can have norm distance two at every step and still share one weak-star ground limit when their separating observable depends on n.
- **Decision reason:** The differential KMS inequality gives a beta-dependent lower energy-form error that vanishes at zero temperature. Common-core generator convergence identifies the limiting energy form and target invariance, while graph-core closure promotes both statements to the full generator domain. A fixed odd witness preserves distinctness under weak-star convergence. The C([-1,1]) evaluation fixture proves that finite-step norm separation, purity and extremality alone do not replace that fixed witness.
- **Boundary:** This is T0 and claim_bearing:false. It is an abstract conditional transfer theorem and an exact automatic-implication failure. It proves no infinite-beta KMS label, purity or extremality of the limits, factoriality, disjointness, clustering, simple ground kernel, broken-sector GNS gap, mass gap, full-oscillator two-phase theorem, selector removal, regulator removal, continuum, physical vacuum comparison, Round-1, C6, CP1, physical Sector A or Pre-A closure. No v3.2 PDF is issued.
- **Next / revisit condition:** For exact Q3, construct one noncollapsing spatial carrier and target point-norm C0 action, identify two phase-labelled KMS sequences on that carrier, prove norm convergence of both phase generators on one graph core, and retain one fixed bounded odd witness with a uniform sign. - **Question:** Does the exact Q3 affine relative-form envelope supply an integrable full-oscillator first-Duhamel trace-norm bound and spectral Ritz removal despite failure of the v3.6 symmetric Holder majorant?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Factor the Gibbs-dressed perturbation asymmetrically on the two half intervals, using one B^(1/2) factor in trace norm and the other in operator norm. (2) Integrate the resulting square-root endpoint singularities and apply Bochner dominated convergence to increasing spectral Ritz compressions. (3) Use trace-ideal cyclicity to derive the scalar first-coefficient identity and bound the Gibbs trace factor by heat traces. (4) Instantiate the affine theorem with the inherited exact-Q3 edge form envelope and audit it with an independently derived three-level noncommuting fixture.
- **Finding:** For h>=0 with Gibbs heat trace, B=a h+bI and V=B^(1/2) C B^(1/2), the first Duhamel integrand has an integrable reflected half-interval trace-norm majorant whose integral is at most A_beta[beta sqrt(b)+2 sqrt(a beta/e)]. The exact Q3 edge envelope therefore has full-oscillator first-Duhamel spectral-Ritz removal for every fixed N and beta>0 without the v3.6 symmetric-majorant L1 premise.
- **Decision reason:** The load-bearing S1-operator-S1 factorization leaves only an integrable s^(-1/2) endpoint singularity, whereas the symmetric Holder majorant can behave as s^(-1). The Q3 relative-form certificate has exactly the required affine envelope, so the abstract theorem applies without a new model hypothesis.

- **Question:** Can the v4.0 categorical ground pair discharge the energy-identity and centered-form-core premises of the phasewise gap criterion, and can its full mesoscopic finite gaps provide a uniform Poincare input?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Differentiate the canonical covariant GNS implementation on the compact-Arveson graph core and identify the exact state energy with the implementing-Hamiltonian quadratic form. (2) Use spectral mollifiers with compact energy support to prove that centered bandlimited cyclic vectors form an H_sigma^(1/2) form core on the vacuum orthogonal complement, then derive the exact Rayleigh characterization. (3) Use parity covariance to construct the twisted unitary equivalence of the two GNS Hamiltonians and prove equality of their Poincare constants. (4) Combine the fixed v4.0 separator with the opposite-source overlap and an exact orthogonal branch-switching trial to audit whether the full mesoscopic finite-volume gap can supply a positive uniform coercive input.
- **Finding:** For each v4.0 categorical ground state, -i hbar omega_sigma(A^*delta_H A) equals the H_sigma^(1/2)-energy of the centered GNS vector for every A in D_bl, and those vectors form a form core on Omega_sigma^perp. The exact phasewise Rayleigh constant is therefore the infimum over fixed D_bl observables; positivity is equivalent to a positive implementing gap and forces a simple kernel. Parity makes the two constants equal. In contrast, the exact mesoscopic source Hamiltonians satisfy Delta_(L,sigma)^full <=[32sqrt(B_a)/(r_w^2rho_*)]h_LV->0, so their full finite gaps cannot furnish the missing uniform phasewise Poincare bound.
- **Decision reason:** The package closes the previously assumed categorical implementing-energy and centered form-core inputs without assuming a simple kernel, while the exact global branch-switching trial prevents an invalid transfer from finite-source full gaps. It leaves the genuinely load-bearing fixed-carrier positive coercive lower bound explicit.

The global volume-dependent finite-source trial does not refute a phasewise target gap. No positive fixed-D_bl coercivity, simple kernel, broken-sector GNS or physical mass gap, spatial all-exhaustion or raw oscillator common alpha, DLR/OS/KMS branch identification, purity, factoriality, phase exhaustion, regulator or continuum removal, physical vacuum or empty-space comparison, Round-1, C6, CP1, physical Sector A or Pre-A closure follows. (3) At each scale, extract the Voronoi/Delaunay complex and track normalized truncated-octahedron signature, cell-volume distribution, face-number distribution, defect density, neighbor-switch events, and renormalized energy density. (4) Require comparison after rescaling by the evolving characteristic cell length, as in foam coarsening, rather than preservation of an absolute cell size. (5) Reject the attractor interpretation if the truncated-octahedron signature has no reproducible basin advantage over controls or if apparent persistence is removed by a normalization, center-definition, or finite-box change.
- **Finding:** Yes, as a falsifiable analogue diagnostic. In coarsening foam, geometry evolves continuously while cell-network topology changes discretely; a candidate cell signature must therefore be evaluated after rescaling by its evolving characteristic length and against defect/transition statistics, rather than by one static visual match. This does not make a foam a TECT model or make a gradient-flow parameter physical time.
- **Decision reason:** A static truncated-octahedron fit can be accidental. Coarsening supplies adverse perturbations: small cells disappear, large cells grow, and neighbor exchanges change the cell complex. A structural candidate that repeatedly survives these normalized tests is more constrained than one selected from a single configuration; a signature that rapidly disappears is a direct route filter.
- **Boundary:** Foam coarsening is driven by diffusion, Laplace pressure, and surface tension; it does not derive TECT dynamics. A TECT gradient flow is an optimization/relaxation tool unless independently connected to a relational clock and physical kinetics. Passing the diagnostic proves neither vacuum selection nor physical time.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Extend T-055's manifest with center-extraction invariance, rescaled coarsening observables, competitor seeds, finite-volume checks, and an explicit no-physical-time label before any simulation is interpreted.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-000848](#exp-000848)

<a id="exp-000850"></a>
#### EXP-000850 — Freeze the geometry-first and Q3LOCK auxiliary lanes with a no-cross-promotion interface

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-14; recorded 2026-08-14T03:24:23Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [B1-RH-ENUM](../claims/B1-RH-ENUM/claim.md), [B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING](../claims/B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [C6-BCC-PREMISE-BLOCKED](../claims/GATES.md#c6-bcc-premise-blocked), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-055`.
- **Question:** How should the truncated-octahedron/Reading-H structural candidate and Q3LOCK proof programme be arranged so that each can advance or fail without importing an unproved conclusion from the other?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Geometry lane order: freeze center/cell extraction and competitors; compare F_ren[realization]-F_ren[0]; test symmetry-projected transverse Hessian; test finite-volume, thermodynamic, and continuum behavior; only then ask propagation/QFT questions. (2) Q3LOCK lane order: preserve exact ground-selection, common-dynamics, phasewise-gap, and continuum obligations and their registered negative controls. (3) Interface rule: every transferred lemma names its hypotheses, regulator, observable algebra, limit order, and whether it is structural, dynamical, or merely diagnostic. (4) Forbidden transfers: no Q3LOCK phase/gap result implies a Reading-H truncated-octahedron vacuum; no foam or geometry result implies common alpha, emergent time, or a physical mass gap. (5) Review the allocation at each logical gate: a failed geometry sign/stability test redirects the candidate set; a Q3LOCK no-go refines tools but does not veto untested geometry.
- **Finding:** T-055 is the sole active structural-selection lane: it must establish a declared truncated-octahedron realization, negative empty-reference renormalized energy, transverse stability, and controlled limits. T-054/Q3LOCK is an auxiliary mathematical lane: it preserves reusable common-dynamics, phase-selection, gap, counterterm, and no-go tools. Results may transfer only as explicitly verified general lemmas or diagnostics; neither lane supplies the other lane's physical premise.
- **Decision reason:** The two lines answer different questions. Geometry-first work tests whether a candidate microscopic structure is selected at all; Q3LOCK tests which analytical transitions are legitimate in a tractable interacting oscillator system. Treating a Q3LOCK result as geometry selection, or a geometric resemblance as common dynamics or a GNS gap, would repeat recorded scope errors.
- **Boundary:** This is research governance, not a claim that either lane is physically correct. It does not reopen the refuted BCC card, promote Reading-H over the empty reference, or close any Q3LOCK, Pre-A, C6, QFT, or physical-vacuum gate.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Begin T-055 with the minimal candidate/competitor and center-extraction manifest. Keep T-054 available only for bounded Q3LOCK proof work that produces reusable lemmas or decisive route filters with stated interface conditions.

- **Question:** Can one explicit BCC-periodic field and deterministic center rule be frozen inside the hash-pinned neutral P1/A2 functional and tested by R-157 without conflating that fixture with the registered Reading-H Q/G_* object?

(2) Identify the center lattice with the exact R-169 v1.0 BCC Voronoi fixture, count the descended torus cells, and derive the exact L2 norm by Fourier orthogonality. (3) Apply the inherited R-157 energy and radial constants under A2-H3-CANONICAL-PRODUCTION-FUNCTIONAL, and separately audit value and radial perturbation premises with an exact higher-local-minimum counterfixture. (4) Compare the registered Reading-H Q/G_* object with the pinned P1 field domain, normalization, center rule and ensemble, retaining every missing map or intertwiner as an explicit open interface.
- **Finding:** Conditional on A2-H3-CANONICAL-PRODUCTION-FUNCTIONAL, the field Psi_A=A u sum_(n in S) exp(2 pi i n dot x/16), with the twelve BCC frequencies and A nonzero, has exactly 128 modulus-max centers on [4Z^3 union ((2,2,2)+4Z^3)]/16Z^3, the same BCC translation lattice, the R-169 v1.0 truncated-octahedron Voronoi cells, and squared L2 norm 49152|A|^2. R-157 gives an energy margin greater than 6144|A|^2 and radial margin greater than 12288|A|^2, so this exact family is above the zero reference and is not an unconstrained critical point, local minimum, metastable equilibrium or global minimizer. A value-gap perturbation premise alone does not imply radial or local exclusion: an exact scalar fixture retains a nonzero higher strict local minimum of value 25/108. No registered Reading-H Q/G_* to Psi or covariance/composite map, phase and polarization convention, normalization, center/cell rule or energy and ensemble intertwiner exists, so the current B1/B3 ranking is neither promoted nor refuted.

It also prevents a positive value gap from being misreported as critical-point or metastability exclusion without a separate radial derivative estimate.
- **Boundary:** This is T0 and claim_bearing:false. It closes only the declared twelve-mode pinned-P1 fixture conditional on A2-H3. It does not identify Reading-H Q or G_* with Psi, validate the pinned functional as Nature's canonical theory, construct a physical-empty reference, cover constrained or retuned models, pass thermodynamic or continuum limits, select a vacuum, resurrect B3-BCC-STRUCT, or close Round-1, C6, physical Sector A or Pre-A. - **Next / revisit condition:** Freeze an actual Reading-H Q/G_* to pinned-P1 field map or an explicitly different covariance/composite realization, including phases, C3 polarizations, torus embedding, intensity normalization, reference image, center/cell rule and exact or error-budgeted energy/ensemble intertwining; if the functional or ensemble changes, prove the corresponding matched sign, radial and limit estimates before any physical selection claim.

<a id="exp-000853"></a>
#### EXP-000853 — Treat matter-like topological twists as a measured transition-yield hypothesis, not a percentage claim

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-14; recorded 2026-08-14T04:43:13Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **inconclusive**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [B1-RH-ENUM](../claims/B1-RH-ENUM/claim.md), [B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING](../claims/B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-T055-READING-H-REALIZATION-TO-PINNED-P1-OR-DECLARED-ESCAPE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-realization-to-pinned-p1-or-declared-escape), [C6-BCC-PREMISE-BLOCKED](../claims/GATES.md#c6-bcc-premise-blocked), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-055`.
- **Question:** Does a transition of the prospective microstructure create a definite fraction of stable topological twists that can be identified with matter?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Audit the recorded Pre-A ontology, the Reading-H-to-realization interface, and the present fixed-torus realization filter for an existing numerical twist or matter yield. (2) Separate a topological-defect census from an ontology claim: fix the order-parameter space and vacuum manifold, an invariant or charge, a finite-localized-energy and persistence criterion, and a declared equilibrium or quench ensemble. (3) Define each reported yield with its denominator and scale, for example defect number per physical cell or defect energy density divided by excess energy density; vary quench rate, noise, volume and resolution before asserting any scaling. (4) Require a surviving Reading-H realization, matched reference sign and stability before using any census as evidence for matter, rather than importing a fraction from a different model.
- **Finding:** No registered historical authority supplies a reproducible numerical claim that a specified percentage of a TECT transition became twists or matter. The retained ontology explicitly calls stable topological distortions as matter-like modes a research target, not a result. The current R-169 v1.1 fixed-torus BCC-periodic field is a geometry realization that is excluded above its pinned P1 zero reference; it supplies neither a transition ensemble nor a defect census, and it has no registered Reading-H map. Therefore there is presently no evidence-backed percentage and no support for identifying matter with twists.
- **Decision reason:** The idea has a legitimate test template in phase-transition physics, but a number is meaningful only after the microscopic state space, dynamics or ensemble, defect observable, normalization and persistence scale are fixed. None is supplied by the current Reading-H authorities, and the one explicitly tested pinned P1 realization is rejected for its own zero reference.
- **Boundary:** A transition-produced defect density is model- and protocol-dependent; it is not a universal primordial material fraction. A topological label alone does not establish finite localized energy, dynamical stability, conserved charge, particle spectrum or gravitational coupling. Algorithmic gradient flow is not physical time. This record proves no physical vacuum, cosmology, matter origin, QFT bridge or Pre-A closure.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Only if a Reading-H realization survives matched reference and stability tests, freeze one order-parameter/vacuum manifold and a regulated equilibrium or quench protocol, then perform a resolution-, volume- and protocol-controlled topological-defect census with persistence tests and negative controls.

#### EXP-000854 — Register the Weaire--Phelan partition as a named interface-energy competitor and high-energy transition diagnostic

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-14; recorded 2026-08-14T04:56:32Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [B1-RH-ENUM](../claims/B1-RH-ENUM/claim.md), [B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING](../claims/B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [C6-BCC-PREMISE-BLOCKED](../claims/GATES.md#c6-bcc-premise-blocked), [PA-T055-READING-H-REALIZATION-TO-PINNED-P1-OR-DECLARED-ESCAPE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-realization-to-pinned-p1-or-declared-escape), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-055`.
- **Question:** Should the Weaire--Phelan lower-interface-area partition be a formal competitor to a truncated-octahedron realization, and does the early high-energy transition intuition make structural selection inevitable?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Use the Kelvin truncated-octahedron and Weaire--Phelan equal-volume partitions only under the explicitly declared interface-area functional, where the latter is a known lower-area competitor. (2) Register Weaire--Phelan as a named negative-control geometry for the T-055 candidate/competitor manifest, with its two-cell motif distinguished from a monotypic BCC Voronoi realization. (3) For any prospective Reading-H mapping, freeze the center/cell extraction, observable, regulator, common renormalization convention, reference, and thermodynamic-then-continuum limit order before comparing a realization against either geometry. (4) Treat a high-energy transition as a testable mechanism hypothesis: derive its effective functional, order parameter, transition type, noise or quantum state, and kinetics; then measure basin probabilities and certified relative energies rather than infer selection from small interface-area differences.
- **Finding:** The Weaire--Phelan partition is a useful named competitor because it demonstrates that the Kelvin truncated-octahedron partition is not universally minimizing even for the narrow equal-volume interface-area problem. Its reported small area advantage motivates precision near a degeneracy but does not transfer a numerical energy difference, a phase-selection theorem, or a microscopic degree of freedom to TECT. The current T-055 authorities already require lower-area foam competitors as negative controls; this record pins Weaire--Phelan as that control. No current Reading-H realization map or high-energy physical kinetics exists, so structural selection is not proved inevitable.
- **Decision reason:** A named counterexample prevents the geometry lane from treating one-cell regularity as an energy principle. The proposed early-universe intuition becomes productive only when it supplies a shared functional and transition ensemble that can distinguish competing basins and limit behavior.
- **Boundary:** Weaire--Phelan minimizes neither the TECT functional nor a proven early-universe energy. A lower interfacial area in dry foam is not a lower renormalized free energy in Reading-H, nor evidence of a physical vacuum, emergent time, matter production, QFT, cosmology, or Pre-A closure. A small percentage can be dynamically consequential near a specified near-degeneracy, but no such degeneracy, dynamics, or scaling law is currently derived here.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Amend the T-055 candidate manifest to name the Weaire--Phelan two-cell partition as the interface-energy negative control. Before any simulation, preregister a common observable and candidate map, then test whether an actual Reading-H realization has a reproducible basin or renormalized-energy advantage over BCC-Voronoi, Weaire--Phelan-inspired, disordered, and non-truncated controls.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-000848](#exp-000848), continues [EXP-000849](#exp-000849), continues [EXP-000853](#exp-000853)
- **Formal authorities:** [R-169](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-169), [R-2026-06-23-b3-bcc-structural-selection](../negative-results/registry.md#r-2026-06-23-b3-bcc-structural-selection), [NG-2026-08-14-PRE-A-T055-TRUNCATED-OCTAHEDRON-COMBINATORICS-AUTOMATIC-FINITE-REALIZATION-ENUMERATION](../negative-results/registry.md#ng-2026-08-14-pre-a-t055-truncated-octahedron-combinatorics-automatic-finite-realization-enumeration)

<a id="exp-000855"></a>
#### EXP-000855 — Separate Weaire--Phelan motif inequivalence from chirality, directional anisotropy, and physical symmetry breaking

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-14; recorded 2026-08-14T04:59:05Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **inconclusive**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [B1-RH-ENUM](../claims/B1-RH-ENUM/claim.md), [B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING](../claims/B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [C6-BCC-PREMISE-BLOCKED](../claims/GATES.md#c6-bcc-premise-blocked), [PA-T055-READING-H-REALIZATION-TO-PINNED-P1-OR-DECLARED-ESCAPE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-realization-to-pinned-p1-or-declared-escape), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-055`.
- **Question:** Is a Weaire--Phelan realization a better candidate for the asymmetry sought in a prospective TECT microstructure than a monotypic truncated-octahedron realization?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Distinguish local motif inequivalence, global space-group symmetry, chirality, directional anisotropy, and time-reversal or dynamical asymmetry as separate observables. (2) Use the two-cell Weaire--Phelan motif as a controlled comparison against a one-cell Kelvin/BCC-Voronoi motif, without transferring its foam surface functional to Reading-H. (3) For a prospective microscopic realization, require a declared parent symmetry and order parameter, calculate the unbroken subgroup and orbit, and test degeneracy, domain walls, defect charges, fluctuation spectra, and all limiting propagation tensors. (4) Reject any inference from visual irregularity alone: test mirror and inversion operations, orientation-reversed partners, and direction-dependent response separately.
- **Finding:** Weaire--Phelan is more suitable than a monotypic truncated-octahedron tiling as a candidate for internal motif inequivalence because its periodic unit contains two distinct equal-volume cell types. That provides a concrete two-sublattice or two-order-parameter test architecture. It is not, by geometry alone, evidence for a preferred macroscopic direction, an arrow of time, matter-antimatter asymmetry, or chirality: the constituent fourteen-faced cell has mirror planes, and the foam construction supplies no TECT parent symmetry, order parameter, or microscopic dynamics. Whether the global realization is isotropic, anisotropic, or chiral must be computed from a frozen realization rather than inferred from the unequal cells.
- **Decision reason:** The two-cell motif is a useful falsifiable source of internal structure while the absence of a defined TECT symmetry action makes stronger asymmetry claims unsupported. Keeping the categories separate prevents a lower-area foam analogue from being mistaken for a mechanism of physical symmetry breaking.
- **Boundary:** This is a geometry-and-evidence-role audit only. It establishes no TECT realization, vacuum selection, physical symmetry breaking, chiral fermions, gauge group, propagation cone, emergent time, matter origin, gravity, QFT bridge, or Pre-A closure.
- **Next / revisit condition:** If a Reading-H field/cell map is frozen, calculate its exact symmetry group and linearized spectrum for both Kelvin/BCC-Voronoi and Weaire--Phelan-inspired motifs; test invariant scalar energy, tensor responses, mirror partners, defect sectors, and finite-volume stability under one common parent functional.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-000854](#exp-000854), continues [EXP-000848](#exp-000848)
- **Formal authorities:** [R-169](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-169), [R-2026-06-23-b3-bcc-structural-selection](../negative-results/registry.md#r-2026-06-23-b3-bcc-structural-selection)

<a id="exp-000856"></a>
#### EXP-000856 — Register the mixed-condensate binding criterion for two-motif structural candidates

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-14; recorded 2026-08-14T05:06:22Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **inconclusive**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A2-FULL-PRODUCTION-WELLPOSED](../claims/A2-FULL-PRODUCTION-WELLPOSED/claim.md), [B1-RH-ENUM](../claims/B1-RH-ENUM/claim.md), [B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING](../claims/B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [C6-BCC-PREMISE-BLOCKED](../claims/GATES.md#c6-bcc-premise-blocked), [PA-T055-READING-H-REALIZATION-TO-PINNED-P1-OR-DECLARED-ESCAPE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-realization-to-pinned-p1-or-declared-escape), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-055`.
- **Question:** Can two prospective condensates bind through cross-coupling and resonant phase locking to form a stable mixed state lower than either pure condensate and the declared reference?
- **Finite checks:** (1) For each frozen microscopic realization, derive the complete common-parent reduced energy for two declared order parameters A and B, including all quadratic, self-interaction, cross-density, gradient, and allowed resonant phase-locking terms. (2) Test boundedness below and minimize over both amplitudes and all relative phases; compare the certified mixed minimum with the two pure minima and the preregistered disordered reference in the same renormalization convention. (3) Require stationarity on the full admissible tangent and a positive symmetry-projected transverse Hessian for a surviving mixed state, then test finite-volume, thermodynamic and continuum persistence. (4) In a declared transition ensemble, measure basin probability, interface cost, defect production and persistence to distinguish a bulk binding energy from coexistence domains or a transient mixture.
- **Finding:** A mixed condensate is a viable mechanism only if cross-density and resonant phase terms create a bulk energy advantage while the full energy remains bounded below. This is a test condition, not a presently established TECT state. In the declared unconstrained hash-pinned P1/A2 functional, R-157 bounds every nonzero field, including arbitrary two-mode superpositions, strictly above the neutral zero reference; it therefore rejects this mechanism within that exact scope. R-158 separately exhibits a nonzero constrained shell state after an imposed charge or chemical-potential change, but it remains above the original neutral zero reference and is a uniform plane wave, not evidence for a two-motif bound structure. Reading-H has no registered field/energy map to which the criterion can yet be applied.
- **Decision reason:** The criterion converts the two-condensate intuition into a falsifiable comparison and prevents an interface-dominated mixture or a changed ensemble from being misidentified as a lower neutral vacuum.
- **Boundary:** No cross-coupling, mixed minimum, microscopic charge, chemical potential, physical transition kinetics, or Weaire--Phelan realization has been derived for Reading-H or TECT. This record establishes no physical vacuum, matter-like defect, asymmetry mechanism, QFT bridge, cosmology, or Pre-A closure.
- **Next / revisit condition:** When a Reading-H field/cell map is frozen, add pure-A, pure-B, mixed-A/B and disordered-reference branches to its candidate manifest, derive the allowed coupling tensor and phase invariants, and run the common-reference minimization plus transverse-stability and persistence audits.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-000854](#exp-000854), continues [EXP-000855](#exp-000855)
- **Formal authorities:** [R-157](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-157), [R-158](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-158), [R-169](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-169), [NG-2026-08-03-M1-PINNED-FUNCTIONAL-NONZERO-EQUILIBRIUM](../negative-results/registry.md#ng-2026-08-03-m1-pinned-functional-nonzero-equilibrium), [R-2026-06-23-b3-bcc-structural-selection](../negative-results/registry.md#r-2026-06-23-b3-bcc-structural-selection)

<a id="exp-000857"></a>
#### EXP-000857 — Require the multi-condensate candidate class to be derived from spectrum and symmetry rather than opened ad hoc

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-14; recorded 2026-08-14T05:09:54Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [B1-RH-ENUM](../claims/B1-RH-ENUM/claim.md), [B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING](../claims/B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [C6-BCC-PREMISE-BLOCKED](../claims/GATES.md#c6-bcc-premise-blocked), [PA-T055-READING-H-REALIZATION-TO-PINNED-P1-OR-DECLARED-ESCAPE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-realization-to-pinned-p1-or-declared-escape), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-055`.
- **Question:** Should one-, two-, three-, and higher-motif condensates be considered, and how can their candidate class be broad without becoming an unfalsifiable post hoc search?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Derive the candidate order-parameter components from the frozen parent field's soft spectrum, irreducible symmetry representations, conserved quantities, allowed wave-vector resonances, and regulator/volume scope. (2) Preregister a finite component cutoff justified by that derivation, together with the complete symmetry-allowed invariant and coupling tensor; do not add a component or retune a coupling after a failed comparison without registering a changed model owner. (3) Within the declared class, enumerate pure, mixed, and disordered branches and compare their matched renormalized energies, full stationarity and symmetry-projected stability under one common parent functional. (4) Expand the class only when a new spectral instability, symmetry representation, empirical constraint, or independently governed microscopic functional supplies a documented reason; rerun the candidate and reference comparison under the new scope.
- **Finding:** Multi-condensate structures are physically admissible, but unrestricted enumeration over arbitrary numbers of motifs is not a meaningful completeness claim. The correct completeness target is exhaustive coverage within a preregistered candidate class derived from the actual microscopic spectrum and symmetries. At present Reading-H has no frozen field/covariance-to-realization map, so neither its allowed component count nor an exhaustive condensate class is known. The existing one- and two-motif controls are diagnostic seeds, not an exhaustive physical list.
- **Decision reason:** This rule keeps the structural search broad enough to discover composite phases while preserving falsifiability, common comparison conditions, and a clear stopping rule against post hoc complexity growth.
- **Boundary:** No finite candidate class proves that every conceivable microscopic geometry in Nature has been examined. No Reading-H realization, mixed state, physical vacuum, asymmetry mechanism, matter origin, QFT bridge, or Pre-A closure follows from this governance rule.
- **Next / revisit condition:** At the Reading-H realization gate, derive and publish the finite soft-mode/representation inventory, its completeness assumptions, allowed invariant basis, and component cutoff before running one-, two-, three- or higher-motif minimizations and transition diagnostics.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-000856](#exp-000856), continues [EXP-000855](#exp-000855)
- **Formal authorities:** [R-157](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-157), [R-158](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-158), [R-169](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-169), [NG-2026-08-14-PRE-A-T055-TRUNCATED-OCTAHEDRON-COMBINATORICS-AUTOMATIC-FINITE-REALIZATION-ENUMERATION](../negative-results/registry.md#ng-2026-08-14-pre-a-t055-truncated-octahedron-combinatorics-automatic-finite-realization-enumeration), [R-2026-06-23-b3-bcc-structural-selection](../negative-results/registry.md#r-2026-06-23-b3-bcc-structural-selection)

<a id="exp-000858"></a>
#### EXP-000858 — Separate Reading-H covariance data from a pinned-P1 mean and audit direct shell and energy bridges

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-14; recorded 2026-08-14T05:35:36Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A1-PRODUCTION-FUNCTIONAL-REALISATION](../claims/A1-PRODUCTION-FUNCTIONAL-REALISATION/claim.md), [A2-FULL-PRODUCTION-WELLPOSED](../claims/A2-FULL-PRODUCTION-WELLPOSED/claim.md), [B1-RH-ENUM](../claims/B1-RH-ENUM/claim.md), [B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING](../claims/B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-T055-READING-H-COVARIANCE-MEAN-FIELD-TYPE-SEPARATION-AND-EQUIVARIANT-NONEXTRACTION](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-covariance-mean-field-type-separation-and-equivariant-nonextraction), [PA-T055-READING-H-PINNED-P1-NONLINEAR-CONVENTION-AND-TORUS-COMMENSURABILITY-CROSSWALK](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-pinned-p1-nonlinear-convention-and-torus-commensurability-crosswalk), [PA-T055-READING-H-REALIZATION-TO-PINNED-P1-OR-DECLARED-ESCAPE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-realization-to-pinned-p1-or-declared-escape), [C6-BCC-PREMISE-BLOCKED](../claims/GATES.md#c6-bcc-premise-blocked), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-055`.
- **Question:** What exact covariance/composite information can be transferred from registered Reading-H data to pinned P1, and which deterministic mean-field, side-16 shell and full-energy identifications fail without additional interface data?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Use the registered antipodal coefficient convention to derive the real finite shell field, its positive-definite covariance, the isotropic Gaussian-Hartree covariance and the rank-one internal covariance/composite kernels. (2) Construct the scalar-polarized side-16 lift only under an explicit reciprocal-lattice commensurability premise and derive its exact L2 normalization and fixed-intensity ensemble boundary. (3) Apply the fixed-point consequence of translation equivariance to stationary covariance-only data and audit whether a nonzero centered BCC mean can be selected without phase or symmetry-breaking data. (4) Use exact rational Machin bounds and integer-shell enumeration for the literal q0 embedding, then compare the historical Reading-H and pinned-P1 scalar nonlinear conventions and constant-rescaling equations.
- **Finding:** Phase-complete Reading-H shell data synthesize an exact real Bohr field with covariance C_Q, and the isotropic dressing gives a radial covariance C_*; multiplication by the registered projector P_0 gives exact covariance/composite kernels. A conditional commensurate scalar-polarized P1 lift has squared norm 4096 I, but fixed I is a fixed-norm owner. A deterministic translation-equivariant section from stationary covariance-only data has a translation-fixed output and preserving centering or nonzero-shell support forces Psi=0. Exact rational bounds place the literal q0 strictly between the side-16 index-square three and four shells; the commensurate shell-three reinterpretation has eight modes rather than twelve BCC directions. The bare nonlinear defect is phi^4(108phi^2-43)/400 and changes sign at phi^2=43/108, while one constant amplitude rescaling cannot match both powers. Therefore no automatic nonzero mean, exact registered side-16 shell embedding or full-energy intertwiner follows.
- **Decision reason:** The result turns the missing Reading-H-to-P1 map into three independently falsifiable interface obligations and preserves the distinction between covariance observables, selected means, reciprocal embeddings, ensembles and full energy owners. It advances the interface audit without transferring the B1/B3 ranking or declaring a physical vacuum.
- **Boundary:** This is T0 and claim_bearing:false. It closes only two scoped type/crosswalk children and registers three exact implication failures. It does not construct a full Reading-H mean field, map G_* to a selected condensate, prove a full energy or ensemble intertwiner, establish a physical-empty sign or stable realization, exhaust candidate classes, resurrect B3-BCC-STRUCT, close C6, admit Round-1 evidence, or prove physical Sector A or Pre-A. No R-169 v1.2 PDF is issued.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Freeze an explicit phase/origin/polarization or covariance/composite realization owner, declare a reciprocal projection or domain change with an error budget, and prove a common-reference full-functional and ensemble intertwiner before applying R-157 or any physical-empty comparison.

#### EXP-000859 — Adopt a literature-first proof gate and legacy-evidence audit

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-14; recorded 2026-08-14T06:00:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [B1-RH-ENUM](../claims/B1-RH-ENUM/claim.md), [C4-GRAVITY-1LOOP](../claims/C4-GRAVITY-1LOOP/claim.md), [C5-NEWTON-G](../claims/C5-NEWTON-G/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-056`.
- **Question:** How should TECT prevent duplicated proofs of known mathematics while preventing uncritical reuse of legacy, external, or internal results?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Compare the current claim, tier, reproduction, exploration, and QFT-bridge controls with the missing literature-applicability requirement. (2) Specify a source-pinned hypothesis-to-model crosswalk, independent-check disposition, adversarial checks, and residual-proposition rule. (3) Require the same audit for legacy and current internal results before either supports a promotion or physical conclusion. (4) Register a phased audit task for the live Reading-H, QFT, and GR route set.
- **Finding:** TECT already distinguishes scoped claims, hypotheses, scripts, and negative results, but did not require a literature applicability decision before new proof work or load-bearing reuse. The binding gate now requires a primary-source locator, hypothesis crosswalk, exact imported scope, reproduction or independent-check disposition, adversarial checks, and a residual-or-stop decision. Legacy and current internal results remain usable only at their live registered strength; a refuted result is a negative control, and a script PASS is not an analytic proof audit.
- **Decision reason:** The gate redirects effort from re-proving standard mathematics to the first unmet model-specific hypothesis while preventing named theorems, legacy claims, or prior TECT outputs from being silently widened or treated as certified premises.
- **Boundary:** This is a research-governance decision, not a theorem, a literature-completeness claim, a claim-tier change, or a validation of any existing QFT, GR, Reading-H, BCC, or Yang--Mills route. The initial audit task does not itself establish that any source applies.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Under T-056, create source-pinned applicability records for B1-RH-ENUM, C4-GRAVITY-1LOOP, C5-NEWTON-G, and C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE before any related physical promotion or new load-bearing proof import.

#### EXP-000860 — Terminate the registered native Reading-H BCC branch at its exact orbit, cell and native G_* comparison

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-14; recorded 2026-08-14T07:13:29Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A1-KERNEL-CONV](../claims/A1-KERNEL-CONV/claim.md), [A1-PRODUCTION-FUNCTIONAL-REALISATION](../claims/A1-PRODUCTION-FUNCTIONAL-REALISATION/claim.md), [A2-FULL-PRODUCTION-WELLPOSED](../claims/A2-FULL-PRODUCTION-WELLPOSED/claim.md), [B1-RH-ENUM](../claims/B1-RH-ENUM/claim.md), [B2-PROPA-HLAYER](../claims/B2-PROPA-HLAYER/claim.md), [B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING](../claims/B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-T055-READING-H-NATIVE-ZERO-PHASE-BCC-ORBIT-CELL-AND-GSTAR-SIGN](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-native-zero-phase-bcc-orbit-cell-and-gstar-sign), [PA-T055-READING-H-PINNED-P1-NONLINEAR-CONVENTION-AND-TORUS-COMMENSURABILITY-CROSSWALK](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-pinned-p1-nonlinear-convention-and-torus-commensurability-crosswalk), [PA-T055-READING-H-REALIZATION-TO-PINNED-P1-OR-DECLARED-ESCAPE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-realization-to-pinned-p1-or-declared-escape), [C6-BCC-PREMISE-BLOCKED](../claims/GATES.md#c6-bcc-premise-blocked), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-055`.
- **Question:** What exact real-space realization is owned by the registered equal-amplitude zero-phase Reading-H BCC branch, how does it compare with the native isotropic reference, and can a direct rescaling or commensuration identify it with pinned P1?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Synthesize the registered twelve signed {110} modes with their equal real amplitudes and origin parameter, solve the multiaffine extrema exactly, identify the translation lattice, and scale the exact BCC Voronoi fixture. (2) Derive the Bohr intensity and natural-torus normalization, cell count, and translation covariance without treating covariance-only data as an absolute origin owner. (3) Specialize the existing B1/B2 native theorem at the production intensity to compare the explicit BCC branch with G_* inside the Reading-H owner. (4) Test both the side-16 commensuration and the most permissive direct constant-polarization bridge with one field scale and one positive global energy scale, while keeping the fixed-charge ensemble escape separate.
- **Finding:** For A>0 the native field is phi=4A(pq+pr+qr); its only absolute maxima are the two all-equal cosine corners, both positive, so argmax phi, argmax |phi| and argmax phi^2 give one translated BCC lattice. Its Euclidean Voronoi cell is the regular truncated octahedron with 24 vertices, 36 edges, six squares, eight regular hexagons and volume ell^3/2. The natural torus preserves the exact shell and has 2N^3 cells. At I=1/500 the inherited B1/B2 theorem gives F_RH[Q_BCC,A]-F_RH[G_*]>0, so this explicit branch loses to the isotropic reference in the native owner. A direct constant field/global-energy rescaling first forces s^2=1 and c_E=2 from the quartic and sextic terms and then fails the exact quadratic equality; the side-16 and natural-torus owners likewise do not identify the full functionals.
- **Decision reason:** The route now terminates honestly at the strongest owner-supported statement: one exact geometry-bearing native branch and its native loss against G_*. The same calculation prevents its geometric realization from being misreported as a pinned-P1 or physical-empty comparison and exposes the remaining generic interface and reference-sign obligations.
- **Boundary:** This is T0 and claim_bearing:false. It closes only the declared equal-amplitude zero-phase native Reading-H orbit/cell and Q_BCC-versus-G_* comparison and strengthens the retained direct-P1 firewall. It supplies no generic Reading-H realization or full energy/ensemble intertwiner, no sign for G_* relative to a physical empty or disordered reference, no transverse or continuum stability, no candidate completeness, no vacuum selection, no C6 or Round-1 closure, and no physical Sector A or Pre-A closure. No R-169 v1.3 PDF is issued.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Freeze a generic Reading-H realization/reference interface or an explicitly changed owner, then prove a matched physical-empty sign, full stationarity, transverse stability and controlled limits before any C6 or Round-1 use.

#### EXP-000861 — Correct legacy intake to selective main-line preservation

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-14; recorded 2026-08-14T07:34:38Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [B3-BCC-STRUCT](../claims/B3-BCC-STRUCT/claim.md), [C1-LORENTZ-KIN](../claims/C1-LORENTZ-KIN/claim.md), [C2-LORENTZ-EMERGENT](../claims/C2-LORENTZ-EMERGENT/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [LEGACY-SELECTIVE-INDEX-AND-ON-DEMAND-REVALIDATION](../claims/GATES.md#legacy-selective-index-and-on-demand-revalidation), [C6-BCC-PREMISE-BLOCKED](../claims/GATES.md#c6-bcc-premise-blocked); task `T-057`.
- **Question:** How should the main repository retain useful legacy research without copying the complete maintained Contents tree or losing important source text when only the main line remains?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Audit the complete Contents tree, the existing 66 compatibility payloads, the selected source cards, reviewed assessments, generated views, and the first T-055 batch. (2) Separate whole-corpus planning information from sources already selected as important to a live proof question. (3) Remove the duplicate content-addressed object layer, tracked 7,503-path inventory, and empty generated views while retaining selected provenance and reviewed interpretation. (4) Preserve newly selected important sources once at readable origin-mirroring paths and verify every selected source against the maintained Contents bytes.
- **Finding:** The complete Contents tree need not be migrated or terminally classified. The useful durable unit is a gate-linked selected source set with exact path/hash provenance, readable copies of important sources, reviewed achievements and counterevidence, and current-convention revalidation before integration. The 66 existing compatibility payloads, 49 newly selected readable reference copies, 115 source cards, 24 reviewed assessments, and 14 nonempty generated views preserve the current useful organization without the duplicate raw-object vault or full tracked inventory.
- **Decision reason:** This scope keeps the eventual main line self-contained for important research while avoiding redundant storage, thousands of low-value files, and a false completion metric based on corpus size rather than proof relevance.
- **Boundary:** This is a research-governance and storage-scope correction. Selection, copying, summary, search, or a matching hash does not validate a legacy conclusion, promote a claim, establish a physical empty-reference sign, or close C6, Sector A, Pre-A, or the QFT bridge.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Use the same gate-linked selection rule for future legacy work: preserve important source copies and assessments, then revalidate only the material needed by the active proof gate.

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-14; recorded 2026-08-14T09:40:20Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A1-KERNEL-CONV](../claims/A1-KERNEL-CONV/claim.md), [A1-PRODUCTION-FUNCTIONAL-REALISATION](../claims/A1-PRODUCTION-FUNCTIONAL-REALISATION/claim.md), [B1-RH-ENUM](../claims/B1-RH-ENUM/claim.md), [B2-PROPA-HLAYER](../claims/B2-PROPA-HLAYER/claim.md), [B3-BCC-STRUCT](../claims/B3-BCC-STRUCT/claim.md), [B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING](../claims/B3-RH-TESTED-STRUCTURE-RANKING/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-T055-LEGACY-SMA-COMMON-BOHR-MOMENT-RADIAL-OWNER-AND-PRODUCTION-ENDPOINT-AUDIT](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-legacy-sma-common-bohr-moment-radial-owner-and-production-endpoint-audit), [LEGACY-SELECTIVE-INDEX-AND-ON-DEMAND-REVALIDATION](../claims/GATES.md#legacy-selective-index-and-on-demand-revalidation), [PA-T055-READING-H-REALIZATION-TO-PINNED-P1-OR-DECLARED-ESCAPE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-realization-to-pinned-p1-or-declared-escape), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-PHYSICAL-EMPTY-SPACE-REFERENCE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-physical-empty-space-reference), [C6-BCC-PREMISE-BLOCKED](../claims/GATES.md#c6-bcc-premise-blocked), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-055`.
- **Question:** What exact common owner follows after independently revalidating the declared equal-amplitude LAM, HEX, FCC and BCC moments, and what may the preserved finite-grid evidence honestly support?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Recount the signed zero-sum two-, four- and six-tuples independently for the four registered supports, while separating HEX relation coordinates from its Euclidean shell embedding. (2) Insert the revalidated moments into the reconstructed Math396 scalar-SMA formula and parameters, then derive exact fixed-intensity values, derivatives, radial critical points, Hessian signs, minimum energies and strict orderings. (3) Cross-check the cosine and signed-Fourier amplitude conventions, the standard cubic-torus valuation obstruction, the B1 intensity marker, and the finite-box off-grid condition without transferring between owners. (4) Audit the preserved Math396/399/400/424 sources and runs under a narrow nine-source legacy record, and qualify the existing B3 negative and live claim card without revalidating the broad lineage.
- **Finding:** The reconstructed corrected common-Bohr scalar owner has exact moments BCC (15/4,220/9), FCC (27/8,125/8), HEX (5/2,85/9) and LAM (3/2,5/2). At I=1/500 its values satisfy 0 < BCC < FCC < HEX < LAM and all four derivatives are nonzero, so that endpoint is not radial stationary. Unconstrained radial minimization instead yields strict nonzero local minima ordered LAM < HEX < FCC < BCC < 0. The preserved finite periodic run is off-grid-confounded for the exact on-shell Bohr question and cannot bind a continuum or physical-empty sign. This qualifies one evidentiary leg of the existing B3 retirement but does not reopen B3, whose corrected ranking still places BCC last among the four declared bare branches and supplies no transverse, PDE, Hartree, P1 or physical-vacuum theorem.
- **Decision reason:** The exact route closes only after fixing one reconstructed bare owner and keeping fixed-intensity, radial, finite-grid, Hartree and P1 functionals separate. A new negative result would duplicate the existing B3 retirement authority; the honest action is an append-only correction to that authority plus a narrow applicability record.
- **Boundary:** This is T0 and claim_bearing:false. It is not the full Reading-H Hartree functional, A1/P1 F_decl or F_ref, a matched physical-empty comparison, a transverse-stability theorem, a regulator or continuum limit, a BCC selection result, or a C6, Round-1, Sector A or Pre-A closure. No R-169 v1.4 PDF is issued.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Construct a genuinely matched full-Hartree or declared alternative owner with a common physical-empty reference, then prove the sign, full stationarity, transverse stability and controlled limits before any C6 or Round-1 use.

<a id="exp-000866"></a>
#### EXP-000866 — Repair the R-168 generated-reader locator contract under rolling windows

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-20; recorded 2026-08-20T12:47:41Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze), [PA-ROUND1-PER-PARAMETER-COMMON-INPUT-LEDGER](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-per-parameter-common-input-ledger); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does the historical R-168 v1.3 integrated verifier still test authoritative generated locators after later changelog and negative-reader windows roll forward, and if not what correction preserves the proof contract without weakening scope?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Run the registered R-168 v1.3 integrated verifier against the current generated surfaces with --no-store and record every failure. (2) Compare the rolling recent readers with their full JSON locators and append-only source ledgers for the historical EXP-000814/R-168 and negative identifiers. (3) Design a fail-closed correction that keeps schema/count checks, validates historical identifiers through full authoritative locators, and uses reader text only for current counts rather than assuming old entries remain in a bounded recent window. (4) Adversarially test stale-window deletion, locator deletion, count drift and unrelated recent-event substitution before rerunning primary, independent and integrated freshness checks.
- **Finding:** The current R-168 integrated verifier fails three generated-reader checks even though the authoritative full locators contain the required historical records: changelog/index.json recent is a bounded 25-event window that no longer contains EXP-000814, negative-results/INDEX.md is a bounded recent reader that no longer contains the older R-168 negative IDs, and changelog/INDEX.md likewise omits the older event. This is a generated-reader contract bug, not a mathematical failure or a missing authority. The correction must bind historical identity to full changelog/negative locator or append-only ledger data, retain current count/schema checks, and treat bounded reader pages as rolling summaries. A locator deletion or wrong historical event must still fail; an unrelated recent row must not satisfy the historical check.
- **Decision reason:** The R-168 package is historical but its verifier is still used as a current freshness and provenance check. A bounded recent reader cannot be the authority for an old event. Repairing the validator and documenting the correction preserves the original theorem scope and avoids either falsely failing a valid historical package or weakening locator integrity.
- **Boundary:** This is a T0 verification-contract correction only. It creates no candidate, prediction, freeze, physical response, C6 theorem, Round-1 admission, Sector-A result, Pre-A closure, new negative, or new mathematical result.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Patch validate_generated with full-locator historical checks, append the correction to the R-168 certificate and result record, rerun all three current formal lanes plus stored/fresh and release checks, then return to the T-054 common-input ledger.

<a id="exp-000867"></a>
#### EXP-000867 — Test whether the T-054 common-input ledger can close with an empty admitted microscopic set

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-20; recorded 2026-08-20T14:15:22Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **inconclusive**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A2-FULL-PRODUCTION-WELLPOSED](../claims/A2-FULL-PRODUCTION-WELLPOSED/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze), [PA-ROUND1-PER-PARAMETER-COMMON-INPUT-LEDGER](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-per-parameter-common-input-ledger), [PA-ROUND1-ADMISSIBLE-MICROSCOPIC-CANDIDATE-MAP-AND-FROZEN-PREDICTION](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-admissible-microscopic-candidate-map-and-frozen-prediction); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Can PA-ROUND1-PER-PARAMETER-COMMON-INPUT-LEDGER be closed now from the existing M0/M1/M2/M5 manifests and the R-168/R-170 audit, or does closure require a nonempty admitted microscopic candidate and candidate-neutral ledger?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Read the live Round-1 parent, common-input-ledger, candidate-map, and evidence-role gate contracts together with the R-168 freeze manifest. (2) Compare the M0 baseline and current M1, M2, and M5 manifests for inserted or matched inputs, state/reference, law, regulator, units, nuisance ranges, candidate maps, and prediction status. (3) Apply the minimum_candidate_condition and test whether a ledger containing only M0 or a categorical role matrix would satisfy the gate without promoting a baseline or an unadmitted candidate. (4) Run the existing primary, independent, and integrated R-168 lanes as the current empty-set and schema integrity controls; separate those checks from a non-vacuous common-input proof.
- **Finding:** The common-input gate cannot close non-vacuously at the current checkpoint. The evidence-role freeze supplies a categorical role matrix, and R-168 supplies the declared ledger schema, but the live R-168 manifest explicitly records required_internal_input.status=OPEN because the current admitted set is empty. M0 is an effective null baseline and cannot be scored as the microscopic winner. M1, M2, and M5 have no admitted microscopic-to-observable map with a nonempty target-free prediction: their input sets, state/reference contracts, regulators and laws are candidate-specific and not a common ledger for an admitted tournament. A ledger containing only M0 would therefore be a baseline record, not the required common-input ledger before a real freeze. The existing three R-168 lanes verify the empty-set/schema boundary and do not manufacture the missing candidate or external commitment.
- **Decision reason:** Closing this gate from a vacuous or baseline-only ledger would violate the registered minimum_candidate_condition and collapse the distinction between discovery constraints, bridge infrastructure, the effective null, and microscopic contestants. The honest route is to keep the parent and common-input gate open while requiring one candidate with an admitted map, a nonempty target-free prediction, and a ledger row for every shared and candidate-specific input before any prospective freeze.
- **Boundary:** This is a T0 route audit only. It proves no physical phase, candidate selection, compact or gauge action, microscopic observable map, prediction, external target commitment, C6 result, Sector-A result, or Pre-A completion. It creates no new result or negative authority and does not close A13 or T-050.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Do not close the common-input gate from M0 or a categorical matrix. Register a new candidate version only after its microscopic map, target-free prediction and parameter ledger are available; then rerun the common-input, admission and prospective-freeze contracts before revisiting A13/T-050.

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-20; recorded 2026-08-20T14:32:02Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **inconclusive**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension); task `T-050`.
- **Question:** Does the current R-108 verifier failure falsify the complete-cluster mathematics, or does it expose a generated-reader contract that still requires historical R-108 tokens from compact current readers?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Run the historical R-108 primary, independent and integrated verifier without importing any proof module and record the exact failed assertion groups. (2) Compare the R-108 manifest, certificate, claim/status, result ledger and full proof-evidence locators with the current generated todo and sector-map readers. (3) Check whether the failed public, scope and reproduction assertions are mathematical hypotheses or historical-reader strings, and inspect whether the no-store invocation rewrites the stored integrated result. (4) Keep the complete-owner, OVERLAP_src, Nelson, removal and Sector-A obligations separate from any reader-contract repair.
- **Finding:** The historical verifier fails 8 reader/reproduction assertions (integrated 222/230; aggregate 378/386), not an R-108 identity, sign, or lower-bound assertion. The R-108 manifest, certificate, claim history and result ledger retain R-108 and the quotient-safe complete-endpoint and square-before-average scope, while current compact todo and sector-map readers are regenerated as current metadata and no longer carry every historical R-108 token. The verifier therefore conflates historical full-authority provenance with rolling reader text. A no-store invocation also rewrites the stored integrated JSON with the failed public/scope rows, so the stored artifact must be restored before any formal freshness comparison. This is a verification-contract inconsistency, not a proof of the missing uniform complete-cluster lower bound.
- **Decision reason:** Historical locators and the mathematical no-overclaim boundary remain available in full authorities; demanding old result tokens from current compact readers is not a valid falsifier. The contract must validate full authoritative locators for historical identity and restrict generated readers to their current schema/window role. The failed run artifact is incidental output corruption and must not be treated as evidence.
- **Boundary:** This is a T0 verification-contract audit only. It neither closes nor refutes the A13/T-050 complete-owner theorem. The uniform signed complete-cluster lower bound, OVERLAP_src, Nelson, regulator/floor removal, interacting measure, thermodynamic limits, Sector A, C6 and Pre-A remain open. No claim tier, negative result, candidate, or physical conclusion changes.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Repair the historical verifier to use full R-108 authority locators for identity and current generated readers only for current metadata; restore the stored result, rerun all three lanes and release checks, then return to T-054 candidate/common-input admission before reopening T-050.

#### EXP-000869 — Separate the M5 candidate mathematics from stale T-054 regression-reader tokens

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-20; recorded 2026-08-20T14:44:09Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **inconclusive**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A2-FULL-PRODUCTION-WELLPOSED](../claims/A2-FULL-PRODUCTION-WELLPOSED/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze), [PA-ROUND1-PER-PARAMETER-COMMON-INPUT-LEDGER](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-per-parameter-common-input-ledger), [PA-ROUND1-ADMISSIBLE-MICROSCOPIC-CANDIDATE-MAP-AND-FROZEN-PREDICTION](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-admissible-microscopic-candidate-map-and-frozen-prediction); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Do the current PA-M5-NL3-SV and R-158 regression failures falsify the candidate mathematics, or do historical verifiers still require superseded T-054/T-050 reader text and R-157 regression strings?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Run the triage, R-168 holdout, PA-M2 and PA-M5 integrated verifiers with temporary outputs so no stored artefact is changed. (2) Run the PA-M5 regression verifier and its R-158 and R-157 child regressions with temporary outputs, then classify every failure by mathematical assertion versus current-record or generated-reader token. (3) Compare the failing T-054/T-050 expectations with the live todo note, current gate status, R-157/R-158 result ledgers and their hash-pinned manifests. (4) Keep the PA-M5 zero-reference, rank-one Hessian, gauge-map and common-input admission obligations separate from regression-contract maintenance.
- **Finding:** The current triage, R-168 holdout and PA-M2 integrated checks pass. PA-M5 stops at three integrator checks: an old T-054 route phrase, an R-158 regression invocation, and an R-157/A2 regression token. The R-158 verifier in turn stops at its R-157 regression and old T-054/T-050 record expectations; the R-157 verifier stops at the same current-task metadata mismatch. The live T-054 note now contains later R-168 and EXP-000867 boundaries, while the old verifiers still demand the 2026-08-03 M1/M5 route strings. These failures are therefore localized to historical regression-reader contracts; they do not by themselves falsify the M5 child calculations or admit M5 as a candidate.
- **Decision reason:** A regression harness may reject a candidate when its mathematical child or scope assertions fail, but it must not treat an intentionally updated current task route as a mathematical invariant. Full hash-pinned R-157/R-158 authorities and current T-054 metadata must be checked separately; the old string contracts need a bounded repair before any M5 admission decision.
- **Boundary:** This is a T0 verification-contract audit only. It creates no M5 admission, prediction, common-input freeze, physical response, C6 result, Sector-A or Pre-A closure. M1 remains excluded in the unconstrained neutral P1 scope; M5's zero-reference, causal-shell, gauge-map and robustness rows remain to be audited after the regression contract is repaired.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Repair the R-157/R-158/PA-M5 regression readers to use current task metadata and full historical authorities, rerun child and integrated freshness checks, then re-evaluate M5 against the common-input, map and prospective-prediction gates without promoting it by regression alone.
