<a id="exp-000870"></a>
#### EXP-000870 — Audit the T-054 common-input ledger against every current candidate owner

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-21; recorded 2026-08-21T00:15:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **inconclusive**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A2-FULL-PRODUCTION-WELLPOSED](../claims/A2-FULL-PRODUCTION-WELLPOSED/claim.md), [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-ROUND1-PER-PARAMETER-COMMON-INPUT-LEDGER](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-per-parameter-common-input-ledger), [PA-ROUND1-ADMISSIBLE-MICROSCOPIC-CANDIDATE-MAP-AND-FROZEN-PREDICTION](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-admissible-microscopic-candidate-map-and-frozen-prediction), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Can the current M0, M1, M2 and M5 manifests be placed in one hash-pinned common-input, common-reference and common-observable ledger without changing a candidate owner?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Read the state space, law, boundary, reference, parameter domain, input accounting and observable-map fields from the four current candidate manifests. (2) Compare volume, regulator, field content, dynamics, reference normalization, inserted parameters, physical maps and limit scope field by field. (3) Check the resulting owner split against the R-168 holdout audit and the R-170 applicability boundary; do not infer a cross-candidate energy sign from candidate-internal PASS rows.
- **Finding:** No single common-input ledger is currently valid across all four candidate owners. M0 is an effective multi-domain baseline with no single microscopic state space, common finite-volume boundary, or global energy reference. M1 is a hash-pinned H2(T3;C3) P1 functional with a neutral zero reference and a canonical gradient-flow or separately imposed charge ensemble. M2 is a real-scalar periodic-torus functional with inserted inertial and double-null toy structure. M5 is a Euclidean Psi-plus-auxiliary-field functional with a separate ordinary inertial test and no defined dynamical law. Their fields, reference conventions, parameter domains, inserted laws, observable maps and limit claims are not interchangeable. The current T-054 evidence, triage, R-168 holdout and M2/M5 checks therefore support non-admission and owner separation, not a common cross-candidate ranking or a frozen microscopic prediction.
- **Decision reason:** A common ledger must hash-pin every shared input, unit conversion, nuisance parameter, uncertainty range, reference state, regulator, volume, boundary and observable map before a prospective candidate can be admitted. Filling missing fields by copying the P1, M2 or M5 owner would silently create a new candidate version and invalidate the preregistered comparison.
- **Boundary:** This is a T0 route and input-owner audit. It does not close the common-input ledger gate, admit M0/M1/M2/M5, create a microscopic map or prediction, compare any candidate to a physical-empty reference, reopen B3/C6, close T-050/A13, or establish Sector-A or Pre-A. R-168 remains a non-selection/holdout audit and R-170 supplies no missing common parent.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Keep the common-input ledger and candidate-map gates OPEN. If a future microscopic owner is proposed, issue a new candidate version with a complete field/parameter/reference/regulator/unit/observable ledger, a hash-pinned common parent and a prospective non-fitting prediction before any energy or score is compared. Do not resume the parked T-050/A13 complete-owner theorem as a physical main route until that owner and its finite production cylinder are frozen.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-000869](#exp-000869)
- **Formal authorities:** [R-168](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-168), [R-170](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-170)
- **Located evidence:** [`strategy/pre-a-m0-established-low-energy-baseline-manifest.json`](../strategy/pre-a-m0-established-low-energy-baseline-manifest.json) (state_and_degrees_of_freedom); [`strategy/pre-a-m1-current-production-functional-candidate-manifest.json`](../strategy/pre-a-m1-current-production-functional-candidate-manifest.json) (state_and_degrees_of_freedom); [`strategy/pre-a-pa-m2-ci8-rs-dual-lane-manifest.json`](../strategy/pre-a-pa-m2-ci8-rs-dual-lane-manifest.json) (functional); [`strategy/pre-a-pa-m5-nl3-sv-candidate-manifest.json`](../strategy/pre-a-pa-m5-nl3-sv-candidate-manifest.json) (functional); [`strategy/pre-a-round1-admission-discriminator-freeze-260810-v1.0.json`](../strategy/pre-a-round1-admission-discriminator-freeze-260810-v1.0.json) (common_reference_observable_input_ledger); [`claims/GATES.md`](../claims/GATES.md) (pa-round1-per-parameter-common-input-ledger); [`explorations/log.jsonl`](../explorations/log.jsonl) (exp-000869); [`RESULTS-LEDGER.md`](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md) (r-168); [`RESULTS-LEDGER.md`](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md) (r-170)

#### EXP-000871 — Separate integrated T-055 mathematics from stale historical verifier lifecycle contracts

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-21; recorded 2026-08-21T00:40:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **inconclusive**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-T055-READING-H-REALIZATION-TO-PINNED-P1-OR-DECLARED-ESCAPE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-realization-to-pinned-p1-or-declared-escape), [C6-BCC-PREMISE-BLOCKED](../claims/GATES.md#c6-bcc-premise-blocked); task `T-055`.
- **Question:** Do the current T-055 v1.0-v1.4 verifier failures falsify their geometry, covariance, native-owner or common-Bohr mathematics, or do they require historical-reader repair after later append-only authorities and R-157/R-158 manifest corrections?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Run the four registered T-055 integrated verifiers in staged no-store mode against the current generated tree and classify every failure before changing a theorem assertion. (2) Compare each failure with the current full authority, event ordinal, generated counts and current R-157/R-158 manifest hashes; distinguish mathematical derivation rows from lifecycle, reader-window and provenance rows. (3) Repair only historical reader contracts: use unique event-id locators, accept later append-only counts monotonically, and bind current superseding R-157/R-158 hashes without broadening any theorem scope. (4) Rerun primary and non-importing independent children plus integrated freshness and release checks, and adversarially reject any mutation that would turn a later reader repair into a new physical or P1 conclusion.
- **Finding:** The four current failures are contract drift, not mathematical counterexamples. The v1.0 reader still expects the pre-R-169 global counts; v1.2 and v1.3 expect superseded R-157/R-158 manifest hashes; and v1.2/v1.3/v1.4 staged lifecycle checks still demand preformal absence even though their append-only authorities are already integrated. No geometry, covariance, native Q-versus-G_* sign, nonlinear convention, radial-order, or no-overclaim row failed before those reader contracts stopped. The repair must preserve each historical event and theorem scope, treat later counts as append-only state, and keep the Reading-H-to-P1, physical-empty and C6 parent gates open.
- **Decision reason:** A historical verifier that requires its original snapshot to remain the last event or to have its authorities absent cannot be a current regression reader in an append-only proof ledger. Updating that reader to locate its own event and current source authorities is a verification correction, not a promotion or a new negative result.
- **Boundary:** No T-055 child is promoted beyond its registered T0 scope. R-169 v1.0 remains the affine/truncated-octahedron and matched-sign route; v1.2 remains covariance/P1 interface firewalls; v1.3 remains the native equal-amplitude zero-phase BCC orbit and Q-versus-G_* sign; v1.4 remains the reconstructed scalar common-Bohr owner audit. None supplies a physical-empty comparison, a full Reading-H-to-P1 energy map, transverse/continuum stability, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A closure.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Patch the historical lifecycle and current-authority readers, update only superseded R-157/R-158 source hashes in the v1.2/v1.3 manifests and their downstream pins, rerun all four T-055 packages, then return to the still-open physical-empty/common-parent proof obligation.

<a id="exp-000872"></a>
#### EXP-000872 — Finite common-input ledger audit leaves the current Pre-A contestant set unadmitted

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-21; recorded 2026-08-21T00:45:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **inconclusive**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-ROUND1-PER-PARAMETER-COMMON-INPUT-LEDGER](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-per-parameter-common-input-ledger), [PA-ROUND1-ADMISSIBLE-MICROSCOPIC-CANDIDATE-MAP-AND-FROZEN-PREDICTION](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-admissible-microscopic-candidate-map-and-frozen-prediction), [PA-M2-CI8-PHYSICAL-RESPONSE-CHANNEL-AND-ERROR-BOUND](../claims/GATES.md#pa-m2-ci8-physical-response-channel-and-error-bound), [PA-ROUND1-INDEPENDENT-CUSTODIAN-OPAQUE-TARGET-COMMITMENT](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-independent-custodian-opaque-target-commitment); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Can the registered M0, M1, M2 and M5 manifests be assigned one exact per-parameter common-input ledger and a target-blind cross-candidate comparison contract satisfying the frozen Round-1 bridge?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Load the current hash-pinned M0, M1, M2 and M5 manifests and the Round-1 admission/discriminator and canonical-functional bridge contracts. (2) Compare the declared state space and degrees of freedom, law/functional and evolution, reference and boundary convention, regulator/limit owner, observable map, and inserted/fitted/derived/predicted/holdout ledger for every candidate. (3) Apply the registered rule that cross-candidate energy or action signs are forbidden until one common unit, state, stress-energy observable, regulator map and additive reference are proved, and that a missing map or target-blind prediction is NOT_ADMITTED rather than an inferred mathematical failure. (4) Run an adversarial scope check against the M1 R-157 neutral result, the M2 finite-torus CI8 results and the M5 static shell results to ensure candidate-internal theorems are not silently promoted to cross-candidate or physical selection claims.
- **Finding:** No common ledger satisfying the frozen contract exists for the current set. M0 is explicitly an effective bundle with no single microscopic state space, regulator, boundary convention or global reference. M1 is a six-real-component H2(T3;C3) pinned P1 functional with canonical L2 gradient flow and a neutral Psi=0 reference; M2 is a real scalar periodic cubic-torus functional with Galerkin/occupation cutoffs, an inserted inertial Lane-Q law and a phi=0 reference; M5 is a C3-plus-three-vector Euclidean-torus static functional with auxiliary elimination and no declared evolution law. Their laws, state spaces, parameter domains, reference owners and observable maps are not the same object. All four manifests also have no admitted target-blind physical prediction: M0 has no microscopic origin prediction, M1 and M5 list no predicted physical outputs, and M2 explicitly has holdout_prediction=false and physical_predictions=[]. Therefore only candidate-internal same-reference statements may be signed; no cross-candidate energy/action ranking, common vacuum sign, or Round-1 winner is licensed.
- **Decision reason:** The obstruction is structural rather than a missing spreadsheet row. The bridge contract requires a common state/reference/regulator/normalization owner and an explicit map to each used discovery observable before comparison. The manifests themselves mark the common reference, common regulator, microscopic map and target-blind prediction as absent or incomplete. Treating M1, M2 or M5 as if they shared the M0 baseline, or treating their distinct zero references as one physical empty state, would violate the registered input-prediction and no-double-credit rules.
- **Boundary:** This is a finite T0 route audit and non-admission result, not a universal no-go for any future successor. R-157 still excludes only nonzero order in the pinned unconstrained neutral M1 scope; M2 retains its finite-torus same-reference and tree-level toy results but lacks a physical response channel; M5 retains its static finite-torus lemmas but its bare joint shell survivor is already rejected in its registered scope; M0 remains the effective null baseline. No physical-empty identification, Reading-H-to-P1 bridge, common-Hartree comparison, C6 signature result, Sector-A theorem or Pre-A exit follows.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Keep the common-input and admitted-map gates open. Advance only a named successor that supplies one owner, one target-blind observable map, one explicit prediction and one independent holdout commitment; the first mathematically available route is the existing M2 physical-response channel gate, but it must not be called a candidate or prediction until those artifacts are frozen.

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-21; recorded 2026-08-21T01:00:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **inconclusive**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-PHYSICAL-EMPTY-SPACE-REFERENCE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-physical-empty-space-reference), [PA-T055-READING-H-REALIZATION-TO-PINNED-P1-OR-DECLARED-ESCAPE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-t055-reading-h-realization-to-pinned-p1-or-declared-escape), [C6-BCC-PREMISE-BLOCKED](../claims/GATES.md#c6-bcc-premise-blocked); task `T-055`.
- **Question:** Does any current T-055 authority provide one matched Hamiltonian/ensemble parent containing the native Reading-H candidate Q, the isotropic Hartree reference G_* and a physical-empty comparator E with common normalization, finite parts and a controlled limiting specific gap?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Read the registered B1/cFull authority and its exact scope, the R-169 v1.4 certificate, and the broad and narrow T-055 legacy records at their current hashes. (2) Separate the relative Q-versus-G_* Hartree comparison, the reconstructed bare common-Bohr owner versus its algebraic zero, and any proposed physical-empty/preparation state; require all three objects to share one Hamiltonian or ensemble, units, regulator, additive finite parts, stress-energy observable and limit order before accepting a sign transfer. (3) Apply the finite-volume same-Hamiltonian comparison contract: a thermal or ground relative-entropy inequality is nonnegative within one owner, but a strict physical-empty claim additionally requires a preregistered empty branch and a positive limiting specific gap. (4) Check the conditional transitivity only as a logic consequence: if a future matched parent supplied E and also proved F_RH(Q)<F_RH(E), then the existing F_RH(Q)>F_RH(G_*) would imply F_RH(G_*)<F_RH(Q)<F_RH(E), without supplying the missing E comparison.
- **Finding:** No current authority owns the required triple. The B1 cFull source proves only the relative Hartree statement F_total[Q]>F_total[G_*] in its registered C_full/A1 scope. R-169 v1.4 reconstructs a bare scalar common-Bohr owner and compares it with its algebraic zero, not with the Reading-H Hartree functional or physical empty space. The narrow T-055 record explicitly lists construction of a same-Hamiltonian candidate/G_*/physical-empty parent with matched normalization and finite parts as a next action, while the broad lineage says no source has yet been accepted for the current candidate-minus-empty inequality. The selected records contain no normalized empty preparation, common counterterm trajectory, matched stress-energy observable, or controlled thermodynamic-then-continuum gap. Therefore the only valid current conclusion is the native Q-versus-G_* loss and the conditional transitivity above; no sign for F[G_*]-F[E_empty] is proved.
- **Decision reason:** The missing object is an owner/interface, not an uncomputed algebraic constant. Applying the B1 inequality to physical empty would silently identify G_* with E_empty and transfer between the Hartree, bare-Bohr and physical ensembles. The finite-volume Gibbs/ground variational inequalities cannot supply a strict bulk empty sign without the missing branch and limit data.
- **Boundary:** This is a T0 route audit and interface obstruction, not a new negative result. It does not refute every future empty-state construction, alter B1 or R-169 scopes, identify Reading-H with pinned P1, prove transverse or continuum stability, restore BCC/C6, or close Sector-A or Pre-A. T-055, the physical-empty gate and the Reading-H-to-P1 interface remain OPEN.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Keep the physical-empty and Reading-H-to-P1 gates open. A future advance must first register one common parent with Q, G_* and E_empty, freeze the finite-regulator normalization/counterterms and stress-energy observable, and prove a positive limiting specific gap; until then only the native Q-versus-G_* comparison may be used.

<a id="exp-000878"></a>
#### EXP-000878 — Derive the actual A7 plane-wave endpoint secant sign

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-21; recorded 2026-08-21T02:36:37Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A7-CLASSII-RENORMALISED-ENERGY-COMPOSITE](../claims/A7-CLASSII-RENORMALISED-ENERGY-COMPOSITE/claim.md), [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use); task `T-050`.
- **Question:** Does an actual hash-pinned A1 dual-lattice plane wave give a deterministic A7 Class-II endpoint sign, and does that sign close the complete A13/T-050 owner?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Read the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients, A7 Class-II density and embedded Pauli generators, then freeze the L=16 dual-lattice mode n=(1,0,0) with real polarization e1. (2) Compute q_A, p_A dot d and v_A dot d for the three Pauli generators, reduce the density to one rational bracket in r=s^2, and prove every numerator coefficient is positive from the manifest-derived a,b,c and rho floor. (3) Check the point witness, the exact integral lower bound, an independent stdlib Fraction reconstruction, and hostile mutations for sign, mode, Pauli, owner and route overclaim.
- **Finding:** The actual A7 deterministic Class-II component energy of Psi_amp(x)=amp*cos((pi/8)*x_1)e1 is strictly positive for every nonzero amp, while the zero endpoint has energy zero. The bracket numerator is 2*a*r^2+4*eps*(a+b)*r+2*eps^2*(a+2*b+c) with all coefficients positive, and E_II[Psi_amp]/(amp^4*pi^2)>=16*a>0. Therefore the endpoint secant E_II[0]-E_II[Psi_amp] is strictly negative. This is a model-level relative-sign boundary, not a full-action or physical-vacuum theorem.
- **Decision reason:** The calculation is nonduplicate of R-150's abstract constant-Gram fixture because it uses the actual pinned A1 Pauli matrices, normalization, torus mode and derived coefficients. (2) Compare the elan wrapper path with the installed toolchain-local lake executable and compile Tect/R171.lean directly. (3) Make the bridge prefer a local lake whose toolchain directory matches the repository pin, while retaining PATH and elan fallbacks, then rerun the kernel compile and hash bridge.

- **Boundary:** This repair does not enlarge R-171, A13, T-050, A7, physical-empty, Sector-A, Pre-A, or continuum claims. A successful rerun still proves only the encoded R-171 algebraic proposition.

<a id="exp-000897"></a>
#### EXP-000897 — Lean cross-check the feedback-pulled cross-Hessian margin before the complete owner

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-21; recorded 2026-08-21T14:43:47Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension); task `T-050`.
- **Question:** Does the actual R-178 active cross-owner Hessian remain negative after the R-181 root-feedback pullback, and what margin must the complete owner pay?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Pin the R-178 complete cross-owner manifest and the R-181 feedback mixed-Gram manifest with the fixed Lean toolchain. (2) Derive the active coefficient -(field+current*w1*w2), the cross Hessian, its R-181 congruence, factored quadratics, eigenvalues, and the negative fixture. (3) Kernel-check the same identities in Lean, recompute them with stdlib Fraction matrix multiplication, and reject hostile coefficient, feedback, boundary, and escape-token mutations.
- **Finding:** The active R-178 coefficient is -(2+3*1*2)=-8, so H=[[-8,8],[8,-8]]. Pulling through T=[[1,0],[1/2,1]] gives T^T H T=[[-2,4],[4,-8]], with quadratic -2*(x-2*y)^2 and eigenvalues -10 and 0. The fixture (0,1) is -8 before and after pullback. Lean, SymPy, and stdlib Fraction lanes agree.
- **Decision reason:** R-181's finite feedback envelope cannot erase the actual active R-178 relative-phase cross block. This is a necessary margin diagnostic for the complete owner: heat, forest, low, returned mean, source and sextic diagonal terms must be inserted and paid once before a sign can be asserted.
- **Boundary:** No complete production Hessian, global instability, heat/forest/complement/returned-low owner, source/sextic one-use, finite collar, T-050, A13, Sector-A, physical-empty, removal, continuum, or Pre-A conclusion is advanced. No gate closure, tier change, new negative, or PDF follows.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Insert heat, forest, complement, returned-low, source and sextic diagonal terms into the same pulled phase Hessian and prove an owner-complete lower bound that dominates this exact negative cross block, or record a scoped failure if that margin cannot be paid once.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-000896](#exp-000896)

<a id="exp-000898"></a>
#### EXP-000898 — Compute the exact diagonal reserve required by the feedback-pulled cross-Hessian

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-22; recorded 2026-08-21T15:13:16Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension); task `T-050`.
- **Question:** What exact diagonal reserve must the complete two-root owner provide to dominate the R-182 negative cross block after the registered beta=1/2 feedback pullback?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Read the hash-pinned R-182 active cross scale, beta=1/2 feedback and A13 status, then define the reserve matrix in the original root coordinates. (2) Prove the pulled matrix formula, complete the quadratic with p=d1-a and r=d2-a-a^2/p, and evaluate the necessary witness x=-a/p,y=1. (3) Kernel-check the rational identities in Lean, recompute them in SymPy and an independent stdlib Fraction lane, and apply hostile coefficient, threshold, scope and Lean-token mutations.
- **Finding:** For cross magnitude a, the reserve matrix is [[d1-a,a],[a,d2-a]]. With p=d1-a>0, nonnegativity is sufficient when r=d2-a-a^2/p>=0, because the quadratic is p*(x+(a/p)y)^2+r*y^2. The witness (-a/p,1) evaluates to d2-a-a^2/p, so the same inequality is necessary for a nonnegative original form under p>0. In the isotropic case the exact decomposition is d/2*(x+y)^2+(d-2a)/2*(x-y)^2, hence d>=2a. R-182 gives a=8: the threshold is 16, while d=15 has value -2 on (1,-1), and the pulled coordinate is (1,-3/2).
- **Decision reason:** R-182 identified a negative cross margin but did not quantify the payment required from the remaining owner. R-183 fixes the exact finite acceptance test without identifying any actual heat, forest, complement, returned-low, source or sextic term with the abstract reserves.
- **Boundary:** This is a finite conditional reserve criterion only. It does not prove production lower bounds, the complete A1/A7 owner, source/sextic one-use, a uniform cutoff estimate, T-050, A13, Nelson, an interacting measure, physical-empty comparison, removal, continuum limits, Sector-A or Pre-A closure. No gate closure, tier change, new negative or PDF follows.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Map every actual diagonal and returned term into d1,d2 in one canonical finite cylinder and test the exact threshold once; if the production lower bounds fail, record that finite margin failure without promoting it to a global A13 or Sector-A no-go.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-000897](#exp-000897)
- **Formal authorities:** [R-183](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-183)

#### EXP-000899 — Kernel-check the finite two-block Douglas identity used by the temporal overlap route

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-22; recorded 2026-08-22T00:00:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension); task `T-050`.
- **Question:** Can the finite two-block Cauchy-Douglas contraction underlying R-081's temporal overlap reduction be kernel-checked without importing the unproved production or progressive hypotheses?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Read the hash-pinned R-081 temporal-packet manifest and current A13 status, then freeze a rational two-block source/control fixture. (2) Prove the exact wedge-square identity and contraction in pinned Lean over Rat, and derive the same values in a non-importing stdlib Fraction lane. (3) Run the integrated hash, theorem-marker, AST/import, hostile-mutation, append-only event, and stored-freshness checks while keeping OVERLAP_src and both A13 gates open.
- **Finding:** For every rational s1,s2,h1,h2, the exact identity (s1*h1+s2*h2)^2+(s1*h2-s2*h1)^2=(s1^2+s2^2)*(h1^2+h2^2) gives the two-block contraction. The registered fixture (3,4,5,-2) has source norm 25, control norm 29, pairing 7, wedge -26, and gap 676=26^2. The kernel result is parameterised and therefore checks the finite algebra, not the analytic production map.
- **Decision reason:** R-081 already owns the analytic temporal packet reduction but has an open overlap-stable complete-packet estimate. The exact two-block identity is a reusable algebraic component suitable for Lean, while promoting it to OVERLAP_src would conflate finite Cauchy-Schwarz with the missing cutoff-, partition-, and revisit-uniform production theorem.
- **Boundary:** This is a finite two-block identity only. It does not instantiate the production temporal maps, prove arbitrary progressive/revisit uniformity, close OVERLAP_src or Nelson, construct an interacting measure, or close Sector-A, Pre-A, or any limit. No tier change, gate closure, new negative, or PDF follows.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Use this identity only after an actual finite production temporal map and its covariance factor are hash-pinned; then test the complete same-root packet on the smallest overlap/revisit cylinder. If the finite production map cannot be identified, record the interface blocker rather than promoting the two-block algebra to OVERLAP_src.

R-188 adds the exact signed telescope explaining how the missing Jensen branch can cancel only after packet recombination, while an absolute rootwise estimate overpays. - **Finite checks:** (1) Read the hash-pinned A1 production manifest and its standalone backend, including the spectral FFT gradient/Laplacian implementation and all declared parameters. (2) Read the hash-pinned A7 renormalised-energy scope and its Sobolev heat-kernel passage, distinguishing the auxiliary positive Bessel kernel from a time-indexed production semigroup. (3) Compare those objects against the R-192 first-failure contract and the R-193 static-owner non-identifiability witness; require an explicit generator/semigroup, root filtration, raw-current spatial intertwiner or projector, and once-owned q-ledger before treating a candidate as the A13 owner.

R-192 remains correctly stopped at heat_root_incidence and R-193 remains the exact interface obstruction.
- **Decision reason:** The spectral word and auxiliary heat-kernel representation are insufficient owner evidence. Promoting either to the A13 dynamics would conflate static regularity with a time-indexed stochastic/filtration law and would bypass the explicit R-193 non-identifiability witness.

It does not add a theorem, negative result, gate closure, tier change, physical-empty comparison, Sector-A/Pre-A result, thermodynamic or continuum limit, or A13/T-050 advance. The exact finite R-191 telescope and R-192/R-193 Lean checks remain valid, but the production heat/root map, raw-current projector and q-ledger are still missing.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Supply and hash-pin the actual time-indexed production generator or semigroup, measurable root filtration, raw-current spatial derivative/projector, and once-owned nonnegative q-ledger; then rerun R-192 unchanged before any A13 gate decision.

#### EXP-000922 — A6/A7 running-counterterm owner and full-field closure applicability audit

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-22; recorded 2026-08-22T10:00:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **parked**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A6-CLASSII-UV-POWER-COUNTING](../claims/A6-CLASSII-UV-POWER-COUNTING/claim.md), [A6-CLASSII-K-COMPOSITE-DEFINITION](../claims/A6-CLASSII-K-COMPOSITE-DEFINITION/claim.md), [A7-CLASSII-RENORMALISED-ENERGY-COMPOSITE](../claims/A7-CLASSII-RENORMALISED-ENERGY-COMPOSITE/claim.md); gate [A6-CLASSII-COUNTERTERM-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#a6-classii-counterterm-closure), [A6-CLASSII-FULL-FIELD-BARE-CONCENTRATION](../claims/GATES.md#a6-classii-full-field-bare-concentration), [A7-CLASSII-NELSON-EXPONENTIAL-BOUND](../claims/GATES.md#a7-classii-nelson-exponential-bound), [A7-CLASSII-SELF-COUPLING-INTERPOLATION](../claims/GATES.md#a7-classii-self-coupling-interpolation); task `T-050`.
- **Question:** Do the current fixed-floor A6/A7 authorities and R-049--R-052 supply a scheme-controlled running relevant coefficient or counterterm owner together with full-field partition and tightness control, or is the next A6/A7 obligation still unowned?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Read the hash-pinned A6 UV power-counting, A6 K-composite, and A7 covariance-normal energy status cards and manifests, including their declared scheme, regulator, floor, and no-overclaim boundaries. (2) Inspect the R-049, R-050, R-051, and R-052 result sections and saved assertions for a running coefficient trajectory, finite parts, renormalisation conditions, subgraph closure, uniform lower form, partition-function bound, or tightness theorem. (3) Cross-check the live A6 counterterm and A7 Nelson gates against the exact next-action text; reject importing a fixed subtraction, a decoupled product-Gaussian determinant, or an auxiliary Sobolev kernel as the self-coupled owner. (4) Apply the Lean policy boundary: no new kernel theorem is needed because this audit finds no new exact numerical proposition; any future owner must add Lean checks for its exact rational consequences and retain analytic hypotheses separately.
- **Finding:** No current authority supplies the missing owner. A6-CLASSII-UV-POWER-COUNTING proves the positive bare Gaussian derivative contraction and explicitly leaves counterterm closure and full-field bare concentration open. A6-CLASSII-K-COMPOSITE-DEFINITION and A7-CLASSII-RENORMALISED-ENERGY-COMPOSITE close only fixed-floor covariance-normal composite definitions within the declared common-even regulator class. R-051 eliminates the literal fixed-coefficient subtraction as a uniform-coercivity route and records that a running family mass would be a new renormalisation condition; R-052 proves only an independent-coefficient/derivative product-Gaussian determinant and measure, not the self-coupled field. R-049--R-052 contain no hash-pinned finite-part trajectory, subgraph-by-subgraph counterterm closure, self-coupled negative-exponential bound, partition-density convergence, or full-field tightness theorem. Therefore the A6 counterterm and A7 self-coupled Nelson gates remain genuinely open; no physical, continuum, removal, phase, BCC, Sector-A, or Pre-A conclusion follows.
- **Decision reason:** The missing data are load-bearing owner hypotheses rather than a notation or path issue. Treating the fixed-floor composite or decoupled determinant as a running renormalisation prescription would conflate a defined observable with a controlled interacting measure and would bypass the explicit A6/A7 gate contracts. The correct route decision is to require one scheme owner with finite parts and renormalisation conditions, or a separately certified full-field concentration route, before attempting a closure theorem.
- **Boundary:** This is a T0 claim-nonbearing applicability audit. It proves no new theorem or negative result, changes no tier or lifecycle, and does not close A6-CLASSII-COUNTERTERM-CLOSURE, A6-CLASSII-FULL-FIELD-BARE-CONCENTRATION, A7-CLASSII-NELSON-EXPONENTIAL-BOUND, A7-CLASSII-SELF-COUPLING-INTERPOLATION, A11, A13, T-050, Nelson, an interacting Gibbs measure, regulator or floor removal, infinite volume, physical-empty comparison, phase selection, Sector-A, or Pre-A.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Require a hash-pinned renormalisation owner that specifies the complete symmetry-allowed counterterm basis, coefficient trajectory including finite parts, renormalisation conditions and uniform lower/partition estimates; alternatively construct a separately certified full-field concentration and tightness route. Then run primary, non-importing independent, integrated and Lean exact-consequence checks before any gate decision.

- **Question:** Does the registered fixed-floor formula for B(X) already provide the DB and D2B control needed to close the self-coupled A7 Nelson estimate?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Differentiate q_A=(X^T S_A X)/(X^T X+epsilon) directly from the hash-pinned A7 coefficient definition, retaining the positive floor epsilon. (2) Derive the exact first and second directional derivatives of q_A, p_A=2S_A X, and v_A=2(S_A-q_A I)X, and insert them into the quadratic B(X) expression. (3) Compare the resulting finite-dimensional polynomial-growth identities with the A8 decoupled det_2 theorem and the A7 gate's requirement for cutoff-uniform adapted spatial commutator estimates.
- **Finding:** At fixed epsilon>0, with d=X^T X+epsilon, v=2(S-qI)X, the exact identities are Dq[H]=(H^T v)/d and D2q[H,K]=2 H^T(S-qI)K/d-2(H^T X)(K^T v)/d^2-2(H^T v)(X^T K)/d^2. Hence Dp[H]=2S H, Dv[H]=2(S-qI)H-2X Dq[H], and D2v is an explicit finite-floor polynomial-growth expression. Substitution into B gives finite-cutoff DB and D2B identities with constants depending on epsilon and the pinned generators/coefficient triple. This verifies the local smoothness already asserted in the A7 note, but it does not control the spatial products DB(X)[h]DX, D2B(X)[h,k], their adapted Cameron--Martin conditional expectations, or the cutoff-uniform commutators required by A7-CLASSII-SELF-COUPLING-INTERPOLATION. A8 therefore remains a deterministic-background result only, and no self-coupled Nelson or Gibbs closure follows.
- **Decision reason:** The derivative calculation is a useful exact owner cross-check and is distinct from the already closed decoupled determinant and the R-171 endpoint witness. It cannot be promoted to the missing gate because the unresolved step is a spatial/progressive estimate, not finite-dimensional differentiability of the coefficient map.
- **Boundary:** No A7 self-coupled negative-exponential estimate, adapted drift inequality, smart-path uniform variation, Gibbs measure, rho-floor removal, physical-empty comparison, Sector-A result, or Pre-A closure is obtained.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Require a hash-pinned spatial/progressive owner for DB and D2B, including conditional Cameron--Martin or smart-path estimates, before attempting another A7 closure package.

#### EXP-000931 — Sharp running-mass domination leaves a noncoercive third-component escape

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-22; recorded 2026-08-22T17:00:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A6-CLASSII-K-COMPOSITE-DEFINITION](../claims/A6-CLASSII-K-COMPOSITE-DEFINITION/claim.md), [A6-CLASSII-UV-POWER-COUNTING](../claims/A6-CLASSII-UV-POWER-COUNTING/claim.md); gate [A6-CLASSII-COUNTERTERM-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#a6-classii-counterterm-closure); task `T-050`.
- **Question:** Does the exact leading W_epsilon contraction admit a minimal running relevant mass that restores pointwise nonnegativity, and does that repair provide the uniform coercivity needed by A6-CLASSII-COUNTERTERM-CLOSURE?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Start from the hash-pinned Fierz identity W_epsilon=9*g*s-6*b*s^2/(rho+eps)-3*c*s^2*(rho+2*eps)/(rho+eps)^2, with s=|Psi_1|^2+|Psi_2|^2, rho=s+|Psi_3|^2, g=a+2*b+c, and the pinned production coefficients b,c>0. (2) For a running linear coefficient h define D_h=h*s-W_epsilon and take fixed s>0 while |Psi_3|^2 tends to infinity; compare the resulting exact limit with h=9*g. (3) Check the endpoint h=9*g algebraically and test whether D_h admits a cutoff- and field-uniform lower bound kappa*s with kappa>0. Keep the resulting coefficient trajectory separate from the original fixed-parameter counterterm route.
- **Finding:** The coefficient h_min=9*(a+2*b+c) is sharp for pointwise domination of the leading contraction on the declared pinned coefficient scope. At h=h_min, D_h=6*b*s^2/(rho+eps)+3*c*s^2*(rho+2*eps)/(rho+eps)^2 >= 0, with equality on the pure-third subspace. If h<h_min, then for every fixed s>0 and |Psi_3|^2 tending to infinity, D_h/s tends to h-h_min<0, so no smaller running coefficient can dominate W_epsilon on all fields. However, at h=h_min the same ratio D_h/s tends to 0 along that third-component escape, so this repair supplies no uniform positive coercivity in s. The sharp running mass is therefore a necessary local stability threshold, not counterterm closure, partition control, tightness, or a full-field concentration theorem.
- **Decision reason:** This is a distinct strengthening of the existing A6 note: the note records that h=9*g makes the leading difference nonnegative, while the exact sharpness and residual noncoercive escape were not isolated as a separate route boundary. The result prevents treating the running-mass repair as a completed renormalisation scheme and identifies the missing estimate that any successor must address.
- **Boundary:** No full renormalised Class-II energy, uniform interacting Gibbs bound, partition-density convergence, tightness, full-field bare concentration, rho-floor removal, infinite-volume limit, physical-empty comparison, BCC result, Sector-A or Pre-A closure follows. The existing fixed-parameter subtraction no-go is strengthened but no new negative result is registered.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Before any counterterm promotion, freeze a full coefficient trajectory including the running mass and the third-component terms, then prove a spatially correlated partition/tightness estimate that controls the h=h_min noncoercive escape; an exact Lean and independent Fraction package should be added if this route is promoted beyond exploration status.

(3) Run the integrated hash and hostile-mutation firewall, preserving the distinction between local algebraic domination and a full spatial renormalised measure.
- **Finding:** The Lean kernel and independent Fraction lanes agree that h_min=9*(a+2*b+c) is the sharp local coefficient on the pinned b,c>0 scope. At h_min the exact difference is the sum of two nonnegative rational corrections, while h_min-1/1000 has a negative registered witness. The endpoint ratio decreases to zero along fixed-s positive third-component escape, so h_min does not yield a uniform kappa*s coercivity. The package therefore certifies a route boundary only; it does not close A6-CLASSII-COUNTERTERM-CLOSURE.
- **Decision reason:** The result is a formalization and independent reproducibility upgrade of EXP-000931, not a new physical theorem. The exact boundary is useful because it blocks both an unjustified smaller running coefficient and an unjustified inference from pointwise nonnegativity to uniform field control.
- **Boundary:** The result remains T0 and claim-nonbearing. It supplies no full renormalised Class-II energy, spatially correlated partition or tightness estimate, full-field Gibbs measure, rho-floor removal, infinite-volume limit, physical-empty comparison, BCC, Sector-A, Pre-A, or gate closure. The existing A6 fixed-subtraction negative is reused and no new negative is registered.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Freeze the complete coefficient trajectory and prove a spatially correlated partition/tightness estimate that controls the h=h_min third-component escape before any counterterm promotion.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-000931](#exp-000931)
- **Formal authorities:** [R-194](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-194), [NG-2026-07-20-A6-NAIVE-W-SUBTRACTION-NONUNIFORM](../negative-results/registry.md#ng-2026-07-20-a6-naive-w-subtraction-nonuniform)

<a id="exp-000933"></a>
#### EXP-000933 — Spatial constant-field lift of the A6 running-mass escape

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-22; recorded 2026-08-22T19:00:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A6-CLASSII-K-COMPOSITE-DEFINITION](../claims/A6-CLASSII-K-COMPOSITE-DEFINITION/claim.md); gate [A6-CLASSII-COUNTERTERM-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#a6-classii-counterterm-closure), [A6-CLASSII-FULL-FIELD-BARE-CONCENTRATION](../claims/GATES.md#a6-classii-full-field-bare-concentration); task `T-045`.
- **Question:** Does the sharp R-194 running-mass endpoint remain noncoercive after embedding the local variables into actual constant fields on the declared finite torus, or can the spatial volume restore a uniform lower bound?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Use the hash-pinned A1 torus parameters to derive V=Lx*Ly*Lz and define the constant real field Psi_(s,r)=sqrt(s)e1+sqrt(r)e3 with s>0 and r>=0. (2) Multiply the exact R-194 local correction by V and prove the volume-cancelled ratio identity in Lean over Rat. (3) For r>=s+2*eps prove the exact bound D(h_min;s,r)/s <= 6*s*(b+c)/r, then choose r=s+2*eps+6*s*(b+c)/kappa+1 for an arbitrary registered kappa>0. (4) Recompute the same identities and witness with a non-importing Fraction lane and run the integrated hash/hostile-mutation verifier.
- **Finding:** The constant-field embedding gives integrated correction V*D(h_min;s,r), and for V>0 and s>0 its coercivity ratio is exactly the local ratio. The Lean theorem supplies the explicit O(1/r) bound, so the r(kappa) family makes the ratio strictly below every positive kappa on this spatial subspace. Volume growth cancels and cannot repair the escape. This is a spatial field-space boundary strengthening R-194, not a full Gibbs or partition theorem.
- **Decision reason:** R-194 already proves the local escape but leaves the spatial interpretation explicit only as a local algebraic statement. The constant-field lift closes that logical embedding gap without claiming that the local density is the full spatial Gibbs action. It is distinct from the A6 full-field concentration gate because it supplies no partition, branch, or tightness estimate.
- **Boundary:** No full renormalised Class-II energy, spatially correlated partition convergence, tightness, full-field bare concentration, rho-floor removal, infinite-volume limit, A7 self-coupling, A13, Sector-A, Pre-A, physical-empty comparison, or new negative result follows. Both A6 gates and all Pre-A/Sector-A routes remain open.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Freeze the complete coefficient trajectory and prove a spatially correlated partition/tightness estimate controlling all nonconstant and branch directions before any counterterm promotion.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-000932](#exp-000932)
- **Formal authorities:** [R-194](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-194), [R-195](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-195), [NG-2026-07-20-A6-NAIVE-W-SUBTRACTION-NONUNIFORM](../negative-results/registry.md#ng-2026-07-20-a6-naive-w-subtraction-nonuniform)

<a id="exp-000949"></a>
#### EXP-000949 — A2 canonical gradient flow does not instantiate the A13 production heat/root owner

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-22; recorded 2026-08-23T01:30:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **inconclusive**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension); task `T-058`.
- **Question:** Can the hash-pinned A2 canonical gradient flow itself fill the A13 production heat/root, filtration, raw-current and once-owned q-ledger contract without adding a new stochastic owner?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Read the A2 full-production manifest and pinned equilibrium scope, including the declared deterministic real-L2 gradient flow and explicit exclusions for A7 covariance-normal composites and alternative dynamics. (2) Compare the A13 R-192 owner-slot contract and the R-193 required-absent fields against the A2 manifest fields and theorem scope. (3) Separate a valid deterministic A2 PDE theorem from the distinct Gaussian heat/root filtration and raw-current/q-ledger data required by the A13 Class-II production measure route.
- **Finding:** A2 is a genuine conditional T6 deterministic PDE theorem: its declared flow is partial_t Psi = -grad_R F_ref[Psi] on fixed T^3, with global H2 well-posedness, energy identity and smoothing. Its pinned scope explicitly excludes the A7 covariance-normal composite, conserved or alternative dynamics, and physical-vacuum selection. The A13 R-192 contract instead requires a common heat/root incidence owner followed by covariance bases, complement, historical low, forest, returned mean, source q-ledger and sextic allocation; the current R-192 audit maps only covariance_bases. The A2 manifest has no heat generator, Gaussian root filtration, raw-current spatial intertwiner/projector or one-use nonnegative q-ledger. Treating A2 gradient flow as that owner would add or replace the declared stochastic production dynamics rather than identify them.
- **Decision reason:** The two flows solve different interfaces. A deterministic gradient flow is mathematically valid in the A2 fixed-torus functional, but it does not supply the probability roots, conditional expectations, root order, or one-use source charges used in A13. Recasting A13 around A2 would be a new model and requires a separate owner theorem; R-193's static non-identifiability remains relevant to the absence of an admitted production map, while this audit does not refute either dynamics.
- **Boundary:** A2's conditional deterministic PDE and R-157 gradient-flow decay remain valid in their pinned fixed-torus scope. No A13 gate, T-050, A7 Nelson bound, interacting measure, Sector-A, Pre-A, physical-empty comparison, removal or continuum limit is closed. No negative result, tier change or PDF follows.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Either supply a hash-pinned A13 production generator/filtration/raw-current projector and one-use q-ledger on the R-192 cylinder, or explicitly register a new deterministic A2-based route with its own owner theorem before attempting any A13 gate closure.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-000948](#exp-000948)
- **Formal authorities:** [R-192](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-192), [R-193](../RESULTS-LEDGER.md#r-193)

(4) Separate reusable BZ/Parseval method ideas from any claim that the H-suppression gate, C1, C6, or a physical conclusion is discharged.

- **Question:** Do selected or canonical QFT, Langevin, or Onsager-Machlup sources supply an A1/A7-compatible production dynamics owner for the R-192 cylinder contract?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Run bounded legacy_search queries over the selected index for QFT stochastic quantization, Langevin generator, heat semigroup, Markov semigroup, and Malliavin or filtration terms under the A13 claim; treat zero selected-index hits as non-exhaustive discovery evidence. (2) Search the configured canonical Contents source root for exact Langevin equation, stochastic quantization, Onsager-Machlup, and generator terms, then inspect the bounded Math98 AddJ, Math98 AddE, and Round-3/4 audit occurrences with their source hashes and line scopes. (3) Crosswalk each occurrence against the hash-pinned A1 kernel and full functional, the A7 covariance-normal owner, and the R-192 required heat generator, root filtration, raw-current spatial intertwiner, and one-use q-ledger fields. Their QFT vocabulary is a candidate interface only; it does not identify the current A1/A7 owner or satisfy R-192.

It does not select a physical real-time dynamics, close A13 or T-050, prove an interacting measure, establish Sector A or Pre-A, compare the physical-empty reference, or close removal or continuum limits. R-192 remains stopped at heat_root_incidence and R-193 non-identifiability remains applicable.

<a id="exp-000956"></a>
#### EXP-000956 — A3 conditional full-production gradient flow is not the missing A13 stochastic owner

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T03:20:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A3-FULL-PRODUCTION-DISCRETIZATION-CONTINUUM](../claims/A3-FULL-PRODUCTION-DISCRETIZATION-CONTINUUM/claim.md), [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does the registered conditional A3 full-production gradient flow supply the stochastic heat/root production owner required by R-192 and A13?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Read the hash-pinned A3 discretization manifest and claim boundary, including the flow equation, domain, conditional A2-H3 hypothesis, and finite-time/continuum scope. (2) Run the A3 one-command verifier with recorded audits in a no-bytecode environment and retain all nine component PASS lines and the 124/124 assertion total. (3) Crosswalk the A3 flow against the R-192 owner slots for a heat generator or semigroup, root filtration, raw-current spatial intertwiner, and once-owned nonnegative q-ledger; distinguish deterministic PDE evolution from the auxiliary stochastic owner used by A13. (4) Apply adversarial checks for silently treating a P1 gradient flow as a stochastic heat semigroup, importing A3 conditionality into A13, and inferring physical real-time or continuum closure from the finite positive-time theorem.
- **Finding:** A3 is a genuine registered conditional dynamics baseline: partial_t Psi = -R[Psi], where R is the real-L2 gradient of the P1 reference functional on the fixed three-torus, conditional on A2-H3. Its recorded verifier passes 124/124, including spatial consistency, finite-time convergence, solution-ball and quantitative majorant chains. However, A3 does not define the R-192 stochastic heat semigroup, root filtration, raw-current spatial intertwiner, or once-owned q_k ledger. It therefore cannot be inserted into the A13 owner order by notation alone; an additional stochastic/filtration and current-interface construction is required.
- **Decision reason:** The A3 gradient flow is derived from the canonical reference functional and is stronger evidence than the rejected generic Math98 import, but its theorem scope is a deterministic conditional PDE discretization/continuum result. Conflating it with the A13 stochastic production owner would add an unproved noise, filtration, and q-ledger interface.
- **Boundary:** This preserves A3 at its registered T6 conditional scope and does not refute it. (2) Construct the finite-dimensional formal candidate dX_t=-M_N grad F_ref,N(X_t)dt+sqrt(2 beta^{-1} M_N)dW_t with constant symmetric positive M_N diagonal in the Fourier/Galerkin basis. This is the legitimate QFT/stochastic-quantization connection currently available from the repository. It must use F_ref, not F_decl: the A1 manifest records a factor-of-two quartic/sextic gradient mismatch and a cKK-versus-cJK Class-II mismatch for the declared execution backend. <a id="exp-000958"></a>
#### EXP-000958 — Exact A1 two-root current exposes a high-high-to-low owner that must be recombined before the q-ledger

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T03:45:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** What does the actual A1 Class-II current do on the minimal two-root field with internal components at k and 2k, and can its derivative be charged root-by-root before a one-use q-ledger is proved?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Use the hash-pinned A1 backend generators T1,T2,T3 and the exact field Psi=(a exp(i k x), b exp(2 i k x), 0) on the declared torus, with real amplitudes a,b and k=2 pi/L. (2) Differentiate the registered m_A=Psi^dagger T_A Psi and J_A=partial_x m_A; verify the trigonometric identities with an independent SymPy exact-algebra command in the pinned TECT virtual environment. (3) Differentiate the current with respect to the two root amplitudes h1,h2 and compare the resulting output norm with separate-root and recombined allocations. (4) Apply the owner adversary: do not infer a full production q-ledger from this finite chart, and do not pay a coherent output twice merely because it has two input roots.
- **Finding:** For Psi=(a exp(i k x), b exp(2 i k x),0), the actual A1 generators give m1=2ab cos(kx), m2=2ab sin(kx), m3=a^2-b^2, hence J1=-2ab k sin(kx), J2=2ab k cos(kx), J3=0. Since rho=a^2+b^2 is constant on this chart, K_A=J_A exactly (the rho regularizer does not alter the identity). Therefore the complete current output is supported at the low frequency +/-k even though the inputs are k and 2k, and sum_A J_A^2=4 a^2 b^2 k^2 pointwise. A root-amplitude variation (h1,h2) has sum_A (dJ_A)^2=4 k^2 (b h1+a h2)^2. The square is a coherent recombined output; separate charges proportional to b^2 h1^2 and a^2 h2^2 miss the cross term unless an explicit same-output recombination and one-use allocation is proved. This is an exact finite A1 chart, not a cutoff-uniform q-ledger or a full progressive/revisit theorem.
- **Decision reason:** The chart supplies a concrete current-level bridge datum that was absent from the generic Math98 discussion, and it identifies the precise high-high-to-low interaction that R-192 must retain. It does not close the gate because the full field/current, heat-root filtration, conditional replicas, output projection, and deterministic summable q_k family remain unspecified.
- **Boundary:** No A13 or T-050 closure follows. The result does not establish a production heat semigroup, raw-current spatial intertwiner beyond this exact chart, cutoff-uniform spatial decay, one-use q_k summability, forest lower bound, Nelson estimate, interacting Class-II measure, physical-empty comparison, Sector A, Pre-A, removal, or continuum limit. The chart must be embedded into the unchanged R-192 owner order before any promotion.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Extend the exact chart to the full two-root spatial/current synthesis with the registered heat action and conditional replicas; define one recombined output charge q_k and test its cutoff/refinement behavior before attempting R-192.

#### EXP-000959 — Heat integration of the exact A1 two-root current gives one recombined low-output charge

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T04:00:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** What is the exact heat-integrated cost of the actual A1 two-root current after the k and 2k root amplitudes are conditionally varied, and does it produce a valid one-use charge?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Use the EXP-000958 exact current variation delta J with output frequency k and a scalar output heat factor exp(-lambda_out t). (2) Let the two root amplitude increments have covariance matrix [[sigma1^2,c],[c,sigma2^2]], and integrate 2 exp(-2t) E||P_t delta J||^2 over t from zero to infinity. (3) Verify the resulting rational expression by exact SymPy integration in the pinned TECT virtual environment and check its nonnegativity only through the positive-semidefinite covariance hypothesis. (4) Compare the resulting output charge with the R-192 atom inequality and keep the low-output/near-output ownership separate from the far spatial-decay ledger.
- **Finding:** The exact heat-integrated chart charge is q_out = 4 V k^2 (b^2 sigma1^2 + a^2 sigma2^2 + 2 a b c)/(1+lambda_out), where V is the torus volume and lambda_out is the positive heat rate on the output mode k. The quadratic form is nonnegative when the two-root covariance matrix is positive semidefinite. The charge belongs to one recombined output owner at frequency k; it cannot be replaced by two independent root charges without controlling the cross term, and it is not a far-output m>k+constant contribution because the chart output is low. Thus the chart supplies an exact finite heat-integrated charge, but not a cutoff-uniform q_k sum for the full A1 current.
- **Decision reason:** This is the first explicit heat-integrated charge derived from the actual A1 Class-II current rather than a generic or scalar toy current. It advances the R-192 owner construction by fixing the correct ownership order: recombine the coherent output first, then charge it once. The remaining missing work is uniform extension over all spatial roots, visits, feedback terms, conditional replicas and the full current.
- **Boundary:** No A13 or T-050 closure follows. The formula does not prove the production heat/root filtration, a full raw-current spatial intertwiner, cutoff/refinement-uniform decay, a deterministic summable q_k family, the forest-current lower bound, source/sextic allocation, Nelson estimate, interacting measure, physical-empty comparison, Sector A, Pre-A, removal or continuum limits.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Generalize the recombined output charge to the complete non-aliased A1 Fourier current, including all output blocks, low/near/far projections, conditional future feedback and visits; test whether the resulting deterministic charges have a cutoff-uniform sum before rerunning R-192.

#### EXP-000960 — Diagonal-Gaussian A1 Fourier current screen identifies the heat-rate threshold

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T05:10:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does the exact A1 three-generator Fourier current admit a cutoff-uniform heat-integrated q-screen in a diagonal fourth-order Gaussian UV proxy, and what heat-rate growth is load-bearing?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Use the hash-pinned A1 generator profile T1,T2,T3 and write the first two internal components as Fourier series. (2) Derive the coherent output convolution C_r,D_r,E_r and the exact diagonal independent equal-covariance spectrum 6|r|^2 S_r. (3) Evaluate the finite Fraction sums Q_N(s) for the proxy gamma_n=(1+|n|^2)^(-2), cutoffs N=1,...,5 and heat exponents s=0,2,4 in primary and non-importing independent lanes. (4) Apply the l1 convolution split: fourth-order tails remain fourth-order, so shell counting separates no-heat growth from heat-rate summability.
- **Finding:** For the declared diagonal Gaussian UV proxy, S_r=sum_p gamma_p gamma_(p+r) is O(<r>^-4), because gamma is l1 in d=3 and has a fourth-order tail. The exact generator sum is E sum_(A,i)|Jhat_(A,i)(r)|^2=6|r|^2 S_r, so the pre-heat current is O(<r>^-2) per output mode. The finite exact Q_N(0) screen grows strictly over N=1,...,5, while Q_N(2) and Q_N(4) are smaller and ordered below it; proxy shell counting gives convergence for heat growth exponent s>1. This corrects the tempting but false fifth-order convolution heuristic and shows that the heat-rate choice is load-bearing.
- **Decision reason:** The two exact lanes agree and the asymptotic split is an elementary l1-tail argument. The result is deliberately only a diagonal Gaussian proxy: it does not identify the A1 production heat generator, filtration, conditional replica law, raw-current spatial intertwiner, or a once-owned q_k ledger.
- **Boundary:** No A13 or T-050 closure follows. The screen is not the full A1 Gibbs law, not the interacting Class-II measure, not a cutoff-uniform production theorem, and not a thermodynamic, continuum, real-time, physical-empty, Sector-A or Pre-A result. R-193 static-owner non-identifiability remains in force.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Select and hash-pin an actual A1-compatible production heat generator and conditional root covariance, then replace the proxy gamma and rerun the unchanged R-192 owner order with output projections, feedback visits, forest, source and sextic slots explicit.

<a id="exp-000961"></a>
#### EXP-000961 — Finite A1 Galerkin QFT candidate gives a conditional Gaussian current heat ledger

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T05:20:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does the hash-pinned A1 quadratic kernel supply a finite Gaussian/OU QFT candidate whose coherent Class-II current has a one-use output heat ledger, and what remains before this can be the nonlinear production owner?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Read the hash-pinned A1 functional, standalone backend, kernel convention, and unchanged R-192 owner-slot contract. (2) Complete the A1 quadratic kernel and prove the exact positive completed-square mass; retain family, lock, and shell terms only as positive-semidefinite additions. (3) Define the finite identity-mobility Gaussian/OU candidate, its mode covariance bound, and the actual three embedded Pauli generators. (4) Use proper complex Gaussian Wick contraction to derive the coherent output current bound with factor 3 times Hilbert-Schmidt square 2, then integrate the scalar output heat once. (5) Run the primary Fraction lane, non-importing independent Fraction lane, and Lean rational cross-check; compare exact ledgers and apply adversarial scope checks.
- **Finding:** For the finite quadratic A1 operator H_n=K_n I_3 plus positive-semidefinite family/lock/shell terms, K_n=r+Z|k_n|^2+Y|k_n|^4 has positive completed-square mass mu_eff=r-Z^2/(4Y)>0. The conditional identity-mobility OU law therefore has C_n=beta^{-1}H_n^{-1} and ||C_n||_op<=beta^{-1}K_n^{-1}. For r!=0, the actual embedded T1,T2,T3 current obeys E sum_A |J_hat_A(r)|^2 <= 6 |k_r|^2 beta^{-2} sum_p K_p^{-1}K_{p+r}^{-1}. One output heat factor exp(-K_r t) gives q_r=6 |k_r|^2 K_r^{-1} beta^{-2} sum_p K_p^{-1}K_{p+r}^{-1}>=0. In d=3, K_n^{-1}=O(<n>^-4), its convolution is O(<r>^-4), and q_r=O(<r>^-6), so the conditional linear ledger is summable. The exact finite cutoffs 1,2,3,4 are nonnegative and monotone in both lanes; Lean proves the factor-six and heat-integral identities.
- **Decision reason:** This is the first QFT-linked screen that uses the actual A1 quadratic kernel and actual embedded current generators rather than an arbitrary external Langevin coefficient. It still cannot close R-192: the OU law is only the linear Gaussian candidate, not the nonlinear A1 production heat/root filtration, conditional replicas, feedback/revisit owner, forest, returned-low, source, or sextic allocation. Treating this candidate as the production owner would repeat the R-193 static-to-dynamics identification error.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing conditional finite Gaussian/OU interface only. No nonlinear A1 Gibbs dynamics, production heat_root_incidence, raw-current spatial intertwiner, complete q-ledger, A13/T-050 closure, interacting Class-II measure, physical-empty comparison, removal, continuum, real-time, Sector-A or Pre-A conclusion follows.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Hash-pin a nonlinear A1-compatible heat generator and conditional root covariance, then rerun the unchanged R-192 slot order. Preserve this linear ledger only as a comparison owner and require the complete feedback, forest, returned-low, source, and sextic slots before any A13 gate decision.

#### EXP-000962 — Finite F_ref nonlinear stochastic quantization supplies a conditional finite generator but not the R-192 production owner

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T06:20:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Can a finite nonlinear stochastic-quantization candidate built from the hash-pinned A1 F_ref supply the missing A13 dynamics without silently replacing the canonical production owner?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Read the hash-pinned A1 functional and separate F_ref from F_decl before constructing any stochastic candidate. (2) Derive the completed-square mass, local quartic/sextic derivative discriminant, and Class-II coefficient determinant using exact Fraction arithmetic in a primary lane and a non-importing independent lane. (3) Choose identity finite-dimensional mobility explicitly, verify the formal reversible Gibbs generator cancellation, and cross-check the algebraic residual, quadratic positivity, and Class-II square completion in Lean R197. (4) Run the integrated lane with source hashes, hostile owner-scope checks, exact lane agreement, and the unchanged R-192 owner-slot contract.
- **Finding:** For the hash-pinned proposed F_ref at finite Fourier cutoff, the completed-square mass mu_eff is positive, the local quartic/sextic derivative quadratic has positive leading coefficient and negative discriminant, and the registered Class-II coefficient matrix is positive definite. With the explicitly chosen identity mobility, the finite generator L_N f=-<grad F_ref,N,grad f>+beta^{-1} Delta f has the formal adjoint cancellation L_N^* exp(-beta F_ref,N)=0. Primary 34/34, independent 30/30, integrated 35/35, and Lean R197 all pass. This supplies only a conditional finite generator and finite heat semigroup candidate. It does not supply the canonical heat-root incidence, root filtration, nonlinear raw-current spatial intertwiner, conditional replica law, or once-owned nonnegative production q-ledger; the unchanged R-192 first missing slot remains heat_root_incidence.
- **Decision reason:** The finite Gibbs construction is a legitimate QFT-linked interface only after fixing F_ref and an explicit mobility. Static A1 data do not select that mobility or identify it with the production dynamics. Finite-dimensional Gibbs invariance cannot be promoted to the interacting Class-II measure, thermodynamic/continuum limit, or A13 one-use estimate without the missing owner slots.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing conditional finite F_ref/Gibbs interface only. No A13/T-050, Sector-A, Pre-A, physical-empty, removal, continuum, thermodynamic, real-time, or production-owner conclusion follows.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Hash-pin a canonical production heat-root incidence, root filtration, nonlinear raw-current spatial intertwiner, and one-use nonnegative q-ledger; otherwise keep the A13 controlled/progressive gates and R-192 owner boundary open.

#### EXP-000963 — Exact nonlinear F_ref mode mixing blocks the naive two-root heat filtration

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T07:20:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does the actual nonlinear local term in the hash-pinned proposed F_ref preserve the naive two-root Fourier filtration required by the R-192 heat-root owner?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Use the declared side-16 Fourier torus and the registered two-root one-component chart phi=z+z^2 with z=exp(i k x). (2) Apply the conjugate Fourier rule to form rho=bar(phi) phi and convolve rho^2 phi exactly over integer Laurent coefficients. (3) Compare the exact output support and coefficients with the input root support, and cross-check the Laurent identity and shifted polynomial coefficients in Lean R198. (4) Run primary, non-importing independent, and integrated lanes with source hashes and hostile owner-scope checks.
- **Finding:** The proposed F_ref local sextic gradient term contains gamma*rho^2*Psi. For phi=z+z^2, rho=2+z+z^{-1}=z^{-1}(1+z)^2 and rho^2 phi=z^{-1}(1+z)^5. The exact output modes are -1,0,1,2,3,4 with binomial coefficients 1,5,10,10,5,1. Therefore the input root span {1,2} is not invariant: lower, zero, and higher modes are generated. Primary 28/28, independent 26/26, integrated 34/34, and Lean R198 pass. This is a precise nonlinear mode-mixing obligation, not a production heat-root map.
- **Decision reason:** The witness uses the actual nonlinear F_ref local term rather than a static covariance proxy. It rules out the naive two-root filtration, but it does not rule out an enlarged projected conditional filtration. Such an enlargement must be explicitly hash-pinned and shown compatible with the production heat/root map, raw-current derivative, and one-use q-ledger before R-192 can advance.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing exact finite nonlinear mode-mixing witness only. No canonical root filtration, heat-root incidence, raw-current spatial intertwiner, q-ledger, A13/T-050, Sector-A, Pre-A, physical-empty, continuum, thermodynamic, or real-time conclusion follows.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Construct and hash-pin an enlarged projected conditional root filtration containing the generated modes, then test its compatibility with the actual production heat/root generator, nonlinear raw-current spatial derivative, and one-use q-ledger; otherwise retain the R-192 first-missing-owner boundary.

#### EXP-000964 — Two nonlinear support closures saturate the side-16 residue lattice

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T08:10:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does repeated local nonlinear support closure from the registered two-root seed saturate the finite side-16 residue lattice, and what does that require of a production filtration?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Start with the registered one-component two-root Laurent field phi_0=z+z^2 on the side-16 Fourier torus. (2) Apply the exact support operation S(phi)=(bar(phi) phi)^2 phi twice using integer Laurent convolution with positive rational coefficients. (3) Check the identities phi_1=z^{-1}(1+z)^5 and phi_2=z^{-11}(1+z)^25, then reduce the second support interval modulo 16. (4) Run primary, non-importing independent, integrated, and Lean R199 checks with owner-scope and finite-only boundary assertions.
- **Finding:** The first nonlinear closure has support [-1,4] and the second has support [-11,14], with strictly positive binomial coefficients. The second interval contains all 16 residue classes modulo the registered side-16 torus, so the two-root seed saturates the entire one-dimensional residue lattice under two necessary support closures. Primary 25/25, independent 25/25, integrated 32/32, and Lean R199 pass. This is a support-invariance obstruction for the naive small root filtration, not a time-evolution or production-owner theorem.
- **Decision reason:** An invariant filtration for the nonlinear F_ref drift must contain every generated block; on this declared finite slice the smallest closure already reaches all residue classes. This does not preclude a full-space projected filtration, but it makes the original two-root owner order insufficient and leaves the heat-root, raw-current, conditional-replica, and one-use q-ledger obligations explicit.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing finite support-closure witness only. No canonical production heat-root map, filtration, raw-current spatial intertwiner, q-ledger, A13/T-050, Sector-A, Pre-A, physical-empty, continuum, thermodynamic, or real-time conclusion follows.
- **Next / revisit condition:** If a production filtration is proposed, prove that its projection contains the saturated side-16 residue blocks and that heat/root incidence, raw-current differentiation, conditional replicas, and one-use q ownership remain valid on the enlarged space; otherwise retain R-192 open.
