#### EXP-000965 — Static finite Gibbs data do not identify a canonical heat-root incidence

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T08:40:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does a fixed finite energy and Gibbs density determine the mobility, heat rates, or root-incidence order required by the A13 production owner?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Fix the registered finite quadratic witness F=(x^2+y^2)/2 and beta=1, while keeping it explicitly distinct from the complete A1 F_ref. (2) Construct the two positive diagonal mobilities M_A=diag(1,1) and M_B=diag(2,3) in the divergence-form Gibbs generator. (3) Derive the stationary-current cancellation, covariance, coordinate decay rates, and root-labelled rate pairs using exact Fraction arithmetic in primary and independent lanes. (4) Cross-check the cancellation and distinct rate identities in Lean R200 and retain the R192/R193 production-owner boundary.
- **Finding:** For every constant positive diagonal mobility M, the Gibbs current M(rho grad F + beta^-1 grad rho) vanishes for rho proportional to exp(-beta F). The two registered mobilities therefore share the witness stationary density, Hessian, and covariance, but their coordinate heat rates are (1,1) and (2,3). Assigning x to k and y to 2k changes the root-labelled heat factors without changing static data. Primary 24/24, independent 19/19, integrated 30/30, and Lean R200 pass. Static F_ref/covariance information therefore cannot by itself select the canonical production mobility or heat-root incidence.
- **Decision reason:** The counterpair is a finite identifiability witness, not a model replacement. It proves that a production heat-root map is a separate authority obligation; it does not say that the current A1 owner cannot supply one, only that it has not been selected by static energy/covariance data alone.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing finite mobility non-identifiability witness only. No canonical production heat-root map, root filtration, raw-current spatial intertwiner, conditional replicas, q-ledger, A13/T-050, Sector-A, Pre-A, physical-empty, continuum, thermodynamic, or real-time conclusion follows.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Hash-pin the actual production mobility/heat-root map and raw-current spatial intertwiner on the same A1 cylinder, then rerun the unchanged R192 owner-slot order before attempting a q-ledger estimate.

<a id="exp-000966"></a>
#### EXP-000966 — Finite covariance-aware A1 Fourier current charge formula

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T09:05:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does a finite QFT-compatible covariance model give a once-owned nonnegative Fourier current charge after a declared heat semigroup, without silently selecting the missing A1 production owner?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Use the registered A1 two-component Pauli current convention and finite 2x2 PSD covariance blocks with an explicit nonzero output mode. (2) Derive the three-generator Pauli/Fierz contraction exactly and integrate the explicitly declared exp(-2 lambda t) output heat factor with the charge prefactor 2. (3) Recompute all rational traces, charges and source hashes independently in two Fraction-only lanes, then cross-check fixture identities in Lean R201.
- **Finding:** The exact finite contraction is S_r=sum_a tr(sigma_a C_right sigma_a C_left)=2 tr(C_right) tr(C_left)-tr(C_right C_left). For the registered opposite-correlation, identity and orthogonal rank-one pairs the exact charges are respectively q=13/4, 3 and 1 at |r|^2=1 and lambda=2. Primary 31/31, independent 22/22, integrated 11/11 and Lean metadata R201 pass. Positivity is a finite PSD/composite fact under the declared heat, not a production q-ledger theorem.

#### EXP-000968 — A6 QFT counterterm Lean registry drift and direct-proof recheck

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T09:45:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A6-CLASSII-UV-POWER-COUNTING](../claims/A6-CLASSII-UV-POWER-COUNTING/claim.md), [A6-CLASSII-K-COMPOSITE-DEFINITION](../claims/A6-CLASSII-K-COMPOSITE-DEFINITION/claim.md); gate [A6-CLASSII-COUNTERTERM-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#a6-classii-counterterm-closure), [A6-CLASSII-FULL-FIELD-BARE-CONCENTRATION](../claims/GATES.md#a6-classii-full-field-bare-concentration), [A7-CLASSII-SELF-COUPLING-INTERPOLATION](../claims/GATES.md#a7-classii-self-coupling-interpolation); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** After the QFT/Lean registry gained R-196 through R-201, do the existing R-194 and R-195 counterterm boundary packages remain directly reproducible, and does that change their mathematical owner boundary?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Compile the pinned Lean entrypoints R194.lean and R195.lean directly under the repository toolchain. (2) Run the existing R-194 and R-195 primary, independent and integrated Python lanes against the current manifests and record the first failure surfaces. (3) Compare verification/lean/registry.json with the historical manifest pins and separate source-registry freshness from the algebraic theorem statements.
- **Finding:** The direct Lean proofs R194 and R195 compile with exit code zero and their theorem declarations are unchanged. The current primary and integrated Python lanes fail closed at the historical lean_registry hash because the canonical registry now contains the append-only R196-R201 entries; the independent lanes can still reproduce the Fraction algebra where they do not require that stale registry pin, but a complete fresh package cannot be claimed. The registry diff is an authority-refresh issue, not a counterterm theorem. R194 still proves the sharp local threshold h_min=9(a+2b+c) with a third-component noncoercive escape, and R195 still lifts that escape to exact constant fields on the finite torus with the volume factor cancelling. Neither supplies a full coefficient trajectory, spatially correlated partition estimate, tightness, full-field Gibbs measure, or A6 closure.
- **Decision reason:** Preserving the old manifest hash would make the current verifier silently accept an obsolete Lean registry, while editing historical manifests in place would erase their original provenance. The correct next action is an append-only R194/R195 registry-refresh correction or a new combined A6 owner audit that pins the current registry and reruns all three lanes. No theorem tier, gate status, negative result, or QFT dynamics owner is promoted by this recheck.
- **Boundary:** This is a T0 claim-nonbearing reproducibility boundary. It does not prove or refute counterterm closure, renormalised partition convergence, tightness, full-field bare concentration, A7 self-coupling, A13/T-050, Sector-A, Pre-A, physical-empty ordering, infinite volume, or real-time dynamics. The QFT connection remains a candidate finite-regulator/Gibbs-dynamics interface until the production heat/root and counterterm owners are hash-pinned.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Create an append-only registry-refresh correction that pins the current Lean registry, reruns R194/R195 primary-independent-integrated lanes, and then test whether the resulting A6 owner contract can advance beyond the constant-field boundary; do not infer a full QFT production dynamics owner from the direct Lean compile.

#### EXP-000973 — Select the finite F_ref identity-mobility stochastic-quantization candidate

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T22:21:02Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Which QFT-compatible finite dynamics should be used as the declared comparison candidate, and does the current evidence identify it as the canonical nonlinear A1 production owner?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Run the current R-197 finite F_ref nonlinear Gibbs candidate package with its Lean Gibbs-residual cancellation and finite coercivity checks. (2) Run the current R-200 mobility/heat-root non-identifiability package to test whether the static F_ref density and Hessian determine the kinetic mobility or heat rates. (3) Run the unchanged R-192 production-cylinder owner audit and compare the candidate against heat_root_incidence, filtration, raw_current_spatial_intertwiner, conditional replicas, and the one-use q-ledger slots. (4) Compare the selected identity-mobility candidate with the discovery-only Math98 external-Gamma Langevin formulas without importing their functional or kinetic coefficient.
- **Finding:** The declared finite comparison candidate is overdamped stochastic quantization of the hash-pinned finite F_ref Galerkin functional with beta>0 and identity mobility: dX_t=-grad F_ref,N(X_t) dt+sqrt(2 beta^(-1)) dW_t. R-197 passes 35/35 and its Lean theorem gibbs_residual_zero verifies the formal finite-dimensional detailed-balance cancellation L_N^* exp(-beta F_ref,N)=0. R-200 passes 30/30 and shows that the same static Gibbs density and Hessian admit distinct positive mobility choices with distinct heat rates, so identity mobility is a model choice rather than a deduction. R-192 passes 58/58 executable checks but remains FAIL_FIRST_MISSING_PRODUCTION_MAP: heat_root_incidence is the first missing owner and filtration, raw-current spatial intertwiner, conditional replicas, and the one-use q-ledger remain absent. The candidate is therefore selected only as a finite QFT comparison dynamics, not as the canonical nonlinear A1 production dynamics.
- **Decision reason:** This route gives one explicit finite generator and an invariant finite Gibbs density while preserving the mobility non-identifiability firewall. It is more precise than importing the legacy Math98 external kinetic coefficient, but it does not bypass the missing nonlinear production owner. Treating it as canonical would conflate static Euclidean data with the heat/root, filtration, raw-current and q-ledger structures required by R-192.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing candidate-selection record only. No canonical A1 production dynamics, heat-root incidence, root filtration, conditional replica law, raw-current spatial intertwiner, one-use q-ledger, A13/T-050 closure, interacting thermodynamic or continuum measure, KMS/OS reconstruction, real-time dynamics, physical-empty ordering, Sector-A, or Pre-A result follows. The Math98 Langevin/Onsager-Machlup material remains discovery-only and is not imported.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Hash-pin the actual nonlinear A1 generator and mobility, root filtration and conditional replicas, raw-current spatial derivative/projector, and once-owned nonnegative q-ledger. Then rerun the unchanged R-192 owner order. Until those fields exist, use the identity-mobility F_ref process only as a finite comparison baseline while advancing the A6/A7 counterterm and self-coupling gates.

#### EXP-000975 — Full side-16 residue closure of the finite F_ref QFT candidate

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T23:10:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does the selected finite F_ref stochastic-quantization candidate admit a closed full side-16 Fourier residue space, and does that closure repair the missing R-192 heat-root owner?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Represent the side-16 Fourier labels by cyclic convolution on Z/16Z and independently reconstruct the non-aliased Laurent witness phi_0=z+z^2. (2) Apply the registered nonlinear operation S(phi)=(bar(phi)phi)^2 phi for two closures in both the infinite Laurent algebra and the finite cyclic quotient. (3) Cross-check the finite generator/Gibbs candidate against R-197, compile the finite cardinality witnesses in Lean R202, and compare primary and non-importing independent derived payloads.
- **Finding:** The full finite Fourier coordinate space is closed under the local polynomial F_ref drift. For the registered two-root witness, the non-aliased supports are [-1,4] and [-11,14]; in the cyclic side-16 quotient the first support is [0,1,2,3,4,15] and the second support is every residue [0,1,...,15]. Thus no proper coordinate projection containing the two-root seed remains invariant under the tested nonlinear closure. The identity-mobility finite Gibbs process remains a valid comparison candidate, but full-space closure does not distinguish k from 2k and does not supply the R-192 heat_root_incidence owner.
- **Decision reason:** A full-residue projection is the honest finite QFT comparison space after nonlinear alias-aware closure. Treating it as a canonical root filtration would hide the mode saturation and would conflate a finite stochastic generator with the missing production raw-current, conditional-replica, and q-ledger structures. The correct result is a route refinement, not an A13 promotion.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing finite QFT-interface and nonlinear-closure result only. No canonical A1 production dynamics, heat-root incidence, root filtration, raw-current spatial intertwiner, one-use q-ledger, complete R-192 owner, A13/T-050, interacting measure, OS/KMS reconstruction, real-time dynamics, physical-empty ordering, removal, continuum or thermodynamic limit, Sector-A, or Pre-A closure follows.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Define a hash-pinned root-labelled heat map and conditional replica filtration on the enlarged full-residue space, then prove the raw-current spatial identity and once-owned nonnegative q-ledger before rerunning R-192. Until then, retain the finite F_ref process as comparison-only.

#### EXP-000976 — F_ref Fourier shell versus two-root production frequency crosswalk

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T23:26:06Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does the finite F_ref QFT Fourier shell identify the k and 2k roots used by the R-174/R-176 production cylinder, or is a root convention/map still missing?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Read the hash-pinned A1 quadratic symbol and the R-174/R-176 root convention from their manifests and executable lanes. (2) Derive h=2*pi/L, the R-176 root norm squares 1 and 4, and the completed-square F_ref scale q_*^2=-Z/(2Y) from the registered A1 parameters. (3) Compare q_*^2/h^2 with the available side-16 integer norm squares, evaluate K at norm squares 1,3,4 in primary SymPy and stdlib-only independent lanes, compile Lean R203, and inspect whether the R-176 integrated verifier pins its manifest kinetic_formula string.
- **Finding:** The executable R-174/R-176 lanes use h=2*pi/L and evaluate root modes with norm squares 1 and 4. The R-176 manifest separately records r+Z*(m*pi/L)^2+Y*(m*pi/L)^4, so its formula string is inconsistent with the executable convention and is not currently asserted by that verifier. The F_ref completed-square scale satisfies q_*^2/h^2=2.999999999993102... for the registered decimals, making the nearest side-16 shell norm square 3; its symbol is K_3=0.2600000000095..., below K_4=0.2837815163755... and K_1=0.3551260654717.... Thus the finite QFT candidate and the two-root production chart are not automatically the same shell/root object.
- **Decision reason:** The mismatch is a provenance and interface issue, not a license to edit R-176 silently. The finite F_ref Gibbs candidate remains a valid comparison model, and the R-176 covariance witnesses remain valid for the executable 2*pi/L roots. Before claiming heat_root_incidence, one convention must be frozen and a canonical map must identify whether production roots are spatial modes, shell labels, or a separate stochastic root coordinate.
- **Boundary:** This is T0 and claim-nonbearing. It does not invalidate the finite F_ref candidate, prove a production heat map, supply a nonlinear raw-current spatial intertwiner or q-ledger, or close R-192, A13, T-050, Sector-A, Pre-A, physical-empty, continuum, thermodynamic, OS/KMS or real-time routes. It does not claim that the decimal near-equality is an exact shell identity.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Freeze the R-176 kinetic convention by an append-only authority correction or an explicit cross-model map, then re-run the unchanged R-192 owner order. The first required production datum remains heat_root_incidence; do not substitute the finite F_ref Gibbs generator.

<a id="exp-000977"></a>
#### EXP-000977 — Finite F_ref QFT dynamics is retained as comparison only after root-map stop

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-23T23:40:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **parked**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** After the full side-16 nonlinear closure and the static heat-map non-identifiability witnesses, which QFT-connected dynamics may be used without silently promoting it to the canonical A1 production owner?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Cross-read the finite F_ref Gibbs candidate (EXP-000962), the static mobility and heat-map witnesses (EXP-000965 and R-193), the full side-16 nonlinear residue closure (EXP-000975), and the frequency convention crosswalk (EXP-000976). (2) Check the R-192 first-missing-slot rule against the fields actually supplied by the finite identity-mobility Galerkin process: generator, finite heat semigroup, nonlinear residue space, root incidence, filtration, raw-current spatial intertwiner, and production q-ledger. (3) Separate a declared finite comparison dynamics from a derived canonical production dynamics and record the stop condition for any A13 continuation.
- **Finding:** The finite Galerkin stochastic quantisation of the hash-pinned F_ref functional with beta>0 and identity mobility is the admissible QFT-connected comparison dynamics. Its finite generator, heat semigroup and Gibbs cancellation are explicit, and the full side-16 cyclic Fourier space is closed under the tested nonlinear drift. However, the nonlinear closure saturates the residue space and erases the naive k-versus-2k filtration; R-193 and EXP-000965 independently show that static inverse-covariance or Gibbs data permit distinct positive heat/mobility maps with different root-labelled rates. EXP-000976 additionally shows that the F_ref shell convention does not automatically coincide with the R-176 two-root convention. Therefore no canonical A1 production heat-root incidence, filtration, conditional replica law, raw-current spatial intertwiner or one-use nonnegative q-ledger has been derived.
- **Decision reason:** Retain identity-mobility finite F_ref dynamics only as a named comparison model. Treating it as canonical would import an arbitrary mobility choice, confuse full-residue closure with a root filtration, and bypass the R-192 first missing production map. The correct next gate is a hash-pinned production generator plus root-labelled filtration and raw-current/q-ledger data; without those data the production route must stop at R-192.

#### EXP-000978 — Cutoff-uniform diagonal-Gaussian Fourier heat comparison bound

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-24T00:11:12Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Can the finite diagonal-Gaussian Fourier heat screen be upgraded to a cutoff-uniform comparison bound without promoting it to the A1 production owner?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Count max-norm shells in Z^3 and bound their diagonal-Gaussian weights by an inverse-square tail. (2) Use the two-region max-norm convolution split to derive a cutoff-independent majorant for the proxy charge at heat exponent s>=2. (3) Reproduce the finite cutoff tables in an exact Fraction primary lane and a stdlib-only independent lane, compile the scalar constants in Lean R204, and exercise hostile scope mutations. (4) Compare the resulting proxy fields against the first missing R-192 production slot heat_root_incidence and its filtration, raw-current and q-ledger obligations.
- **Finding:** For gamma_n=(1+|n|_2^2)^(-2) in d=3, the max-norm shell count is 24m^2+2, the proxy l1 bound is A<53, the nonzero shell sum is <52, and the two-region convolution multiplier is 32. With current factor 6 this gives Q_N(s)<=529152 for every finite cutoff and every s>=2. Primary, independent, integrated and Lean R204 checks pass. The result is a comparison theorem for the declared diagonal Gaussian proxy only; it does not identify the nonlinear A1 production mobility, heat-root incidence, root filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial intertwiner or once-owned production q-ledger.
- **Decision reason:** The uniform estimate is a genuine finite-QFT comparison improvement, but importing it as canonical would conflate an explicit Gaussian proxy with the missing production owner and would bypass the R-192 first-failure rule.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing proxy theorem only. No A13, Sector-A, Pre-A, physical-empty, OS/KMS, real-time, thermodynamic or continuum conclusion follows.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Keep this proxy as comparison-only. Do not rerun R-192 until a hash-pinned A1 production mobility, heat_root_incidence, root-labelled filtration, raw-current spatial identity and once-owned nonnegative q-ledger are supplied.

#### EXP-001003 — Two nonlinear closures saturate the finite side-16 residue lattice

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-23; recorded 2026-08-24T06:23:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **parked**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION](../claims/A13-CLASSII-RELATIVE-PHASE-SOURCE-BUDGET-OBSTRUCTION/claim.md); gate [A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-controlled-shell-energy-one-use), [A13-CLASSII-FULL-PROGRESSIVE-REVISIT-EXTENSION](../claims/GATES.md#a13-classii-full-progressive-revisit-extension), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Can a naive two-root finite Fourier filtration remain invariant under the registered local nonlinear F_ref drift on the side-16 torus?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Freeze the hash-pinned A1 F_ref nonlinear term, root modes 1 and 2, nonlinear power 2, and two support-closure iterations on the side-16 torus. (2) Compute the conjugate convolution rho=bar(phi)*phi and the exact drift (rho^2)*phi with primary and non-importing independent rational implementations. (3) Require the integrated verifier and Lean R199 theorem to agree on the first interval [-1,4], second interval [-11,14], binomial coefficients, and the complete residue set modulo 16. Since those production data are absent, the route is parked and no A13/T-050 or QFT closure follows.

#### EXP-001023 — Finite weighted-conjugation envelope advances a two-orientation Q3 algebraic subgate

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-24T06:43:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-PROJECTED-DUHAMEL-MODULAR-C1-MULTIPLIER-LOCALITY](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-projected-duhamel-modular-c1-multiplier-locality), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does a two-orientation weighted-conjugation envelope supply a non-Leibniz/state-weighted algebraic subgate for the Q3 common-alpha route, and is the reverse orientation genuinely necessary?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Run the SymPy primary exact lane on K=diag(1,4,9), S=diag(1,2,3), a rational 3D orthogonal fixture and exact principal-minor checks. (2) Run a non-importing standard-library Fraction lane with independently implemented matrix multiplication, determinants, principal minors and Frobenius rows. (3) Require primary/independent agreement on the two-orientation bound, finite envelope status, open thermodynamic status and the omitted-orientation witness. (4) Kernel-compile verification/lean/Tect/R207.lean with the pinned Lake toolchain for the generic conjugation multiplication, unit and inverse identities. (5) Apply adversarial checks against finite-fixture-to-operator promotion, one-sided form omission, sample-to-uniform norm promotion, scalar-product-to-limit promotion, Lean overreach and QFT-to-TECT promotion. (6) Keep the QFT-to-TECT firewall: the package contains no heat_root_incidence, canonical A1/R-192 production owner or physical reference.
- **Finding:** Primary 40/40, independent 35/35 and integrated 21/21 pass. The exact finite fixture satisfies both orientation form bounds at M=6 and the product/symmetric-carrier checks. With only the first orientation at M=4, the reverse margin has the exact negative witness -121/125. Lean R207 compiles successfully and checks the generic monoid identities.
- **Decision reason:** The two-orientation weighted-conjugation construction is a reusable finite algebraic lemma candidate for the open non-Leibniz/state-weighted Q3 route. It does not establish the actual unbounded Q3 common core, induced norm, all-shape exhaustion Cauchy estimate, common alpha, KMS identification, ground state, GNS gap or continuum.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing finite algebraic/provenance checkpoint only. It does not close the Q3 common-alpha gate, prove a thermodynamic dynamics, identify common-alpha KMS states, establish a ground state or GNS/physical gap, remove a regulator, establish C6, Sector A or Pre-A, or supply the TECT production owner.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Use the envelope only as a lemma candidate: prove a common-core induced-norm bound for the actual Q3 bond and onsite factors, then prove all-shape exhaustion Cauchy and only afterward attempt common-alpha KMS identification.

#### EXP-001025 — Finite non-Leibniz energy-product envelope is stable, but it does not imply spatial decay

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-24T08:00:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does the volume-uniform Q3 energy envelope close a finite non-Leibniz product topology, and does that topology by itself imply spatial boundary commutator decay?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Define the four finite half-power contexts M_(a,b)(A)=||K^a A K^(-b)||_infinity for K=diag(1,4,9,16). (2) Verify exact context insertion and submultiplicative product bounds in a SymPy primary lane and an independently implemented Fraction lane. (3) Verify both orientations of a unitary cyclic-shift bond, the G endpoint conjugation envelope, and the six-layer/N-step exponential consequence. (4) Test the spatial implication on K=I: a cyclic shift transports a local projector to distance three while preserving every energy seminorm and producing an order-one commutator. (5) Compile Lean R209 for the exact context-insertion, absolute-product and conjugation-factor identities; retain the QFT-to-TECT production firewall.
- **Finding:** Primary 37/37, independent 34/34, integrated 27/27 and Lean R209 pass. The finite non-Leibniz product envelope is an exact algebraic subgate under the declared matrix/common-core hypotheses: M_(a,b)(B*AB)<=G^(2a+2b)M_(a,b)(A), and six matching layers yield a volume-independent exp(6C T(a+b)) bound when G^2<=1+C delta. The K=I cyclic-shift fixture has zero initial distant commutator and unit transported commutator despite unchanged energy seminorms, so the envelope alone supplies no spatial decay.
- **Decision reason:** This closes only the finite non-Leibniz energy-product algebra requested after EXP-001024 and proves an exact necessity witness for an independent spatial first-passage estimate. It does not close the actual Q3 first-passage product, boundary commutator decay, all-shape exhaustion Cauchy, common alpha or KMS route.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing finite algebraic/topological checkpoint only. It does not prove a thermodynamic dynamics, common-alpha KMS, ground state, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or TECT production closure.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Use the finite product envelope only as an energy-side factor in an actual first-passage branch/repeat sum; prove or falsify the two-sided response estimate and record the exact obstruction if the resummation cannot be made spatially summable.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-001024](#exp-001024)

<a id="exp-001026"></a>
#### EXP-001026 — Conditional weighted recurrence yields distance decay, while the Q3 recurrence remains open

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-24T08:30:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** If the Q3 local commutator seminorms satisfy a volume-uniform nonnegative graph recurrence, does a spatially weighted norm imply a volume-uniform distance decay bound?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Use the induced nearest-neighbor boxes of side 3 and 5 with degree bound z=6 and exact weight exp(rho)=2. (2) Verify the weighted one-step inequality W(L_next)<= [1+(C+J z exp(rho)) delta]W(L) for C=J=1 and delta=1/5 in a SymPy/Fraction primary lane. (3) Iterate six steps and verify pointwise distance decay from the weighted norm, with the same constant on both box sizes. (4) Compile Lean R210 for the scalar split-factor, positive-weight pointwise and recurrence identities. (5) Keep the EXP-001025 locality separation and the QFT-to-TECT production firewall; do not treat the conditional recurrence as an actual Q3 theorem.
- **Finding:** Primary 20/20, independent 20/20, integrated 25/25 and Lean R210 pass. Under the explicit nonnegative local graph recurrence, the weighted norm obeys W_rho(L_N)<=exp((C+J z exp(rho))T)W_rho(L_0), hence L_x(T)<=exp(-rho d(x,X)+(C+J z exp(rho))T)W_rho(L_0), with constants independent of finite-box volume. The exact Q3 onsite-plus-bond flow has not been shown to satisfy the required recurrence.
- **Decision reason:** This closes only the conditional recurrence-to-decay bridge and identifies the actual missing Q3 analytic statement. It does not close first-passage resummation, boundary commutator decay, exhaustion Cauchy, common alpha or KMS.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing conditional recurrence checkpoint only. It does not prove Q3 thermodynamic dynamics, common-alpha KMS, ground/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or TECT production closure.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Attack the exact Q3 onsite contribution in the EXP-001025 non-Leibniz/state-weighted topology: prove the recurrence on a declared common core or construct a finite counterexample to the proposed local seminorm.

#### EXP-001027 — Critical two-sided graph seminorm is removed by a frequency-growth obstruction

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-24T09:00:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does the canonical two-sided K^(-1/2)-damped q/p commutator seminorm obey a frequency-uniform onsite bound?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Import the exact Q3 Weyl lower bound from the critical-half authority without re-proving it in this package. (2) Use [q_0,W_a]=a W_a, [p_nu,W_a]=0, K>=1 and Weyl unitarity to obtain L_K(W_a)<=2a for a>0. (3) Set t_a=tau/a^2 and compare G tau a-B_tau against (1+C tau/a^2)2a in exact SymPy and independent Fraction lanes. (4) Compile Lean R211 only for rational slope arithmetic and the finite fixture inequality.
- **Finding:** Primary and independent lanes pass 19/19, integrated lane passes 21/21 and Lean R211 passes. With G=g+3 lambda=51/35 and tau=2, the lower-minus-upper difference is (32/35)a-3/2-4/a, positive at a=10 and eventually positive for all sufficiently large a. Therefore the displayed critical graph seminorm cannot satisfy the proposed frequency-uniform onsite one-step bound.
- **Decision reason:** This is a useful route-level obstruction, not a theorem about all non-Leibniz topologies. It removes the declared K^(-1/2)-damped critical graph seminorm from the candidate tournament while leaving frequency-profiled analytic/Frechet, state-weighted, projected-Duhamel and local-strict routes open.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing route checkpoint. It does not prove Q3 dynamics, QFT thermodynamic identification, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or TECT production closure.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Test a frequency-profiled analytic/Frechet or state-weighted topology, while retaining projected-Duhamel and local-strict history routes as independent candidates; require an explicit common-core recurrence before any QFT interface promotion.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-001026](#exp-001026)

#### EXP-001028 — Conditional first-passage Poisson bridge fixes the boundary-decay target

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-24T10:00:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-PROJECTED-DUHAMEL-MODULAR-C1-MULTIPLIER-LOCALITY](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-projected-duhamel-modular-c1-multiplier-locality), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** If a nonnegative Q3 response has a factorial first-passage expansion with at most z^n paths of length n, what volume-uniform spatial tail follows?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Assume the declared factorial Duhamel path expansion, path-count bound, finite source support and graph distance lower bound. (2) Insert the spatial weight base^d and sum the path terms by the exponential generating function exp(eta*z*t*base). (3) Check the exact fixture z=6, eta=1, t=1/3, base=2 and distance d=10 in independent SymPy and Fraction lanes. (4) Compile Lean R212 only for the rational rate, weight and finite-distance arithmetic.
- **Finding:** Primary passes 20/20 and independent passes 19/19, the integrated lane passes 25/25 and Lean R212 passes. Under the explicit first-passage hypothesis, the weighted generating rate is eta*z*t*base=4 and the distance-10 envelope is exp(4)/2^10, below 0.1. The exact Q3 factorial expansion and its volume/source-uniform path-count bound remain OPEN.
- **Decision reason:** This closes the branch/repeat arithmetic needed after the finite energy envelopes and separates it from the missing analytic Q3 input. It does not establish the actual Q3 response expansion, boundary commutator decay, exhaustion Cauchy or common alpha.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing conditional first-passage checkpoint only. It does not prove Q3 thermodynamic dynamics, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Prove or falsify the declared Q3 factorial path expansion on a common core, including the two-orientation response and a volume/source-uniform path-count coefficient; if it fails, record the exact obstruction.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-001027](#exp-001027)

<a id="exp-001029"></a>
#### EXP-001029 — Scoped common-core obstruction for an onsite-dressed first-passage coefficient

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-24T10:30:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Can the exact Q3 onsite-plus-one-spatial-bond second response coefficient be bounded uniformly by a source Weyl position seminorm that grows only linearly in the translation amplitude?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Restrict the coefficient calculation to the declared polynomial CCR common core and the leading scalar source-degree slice, with the seven other internal Q3 coordinates set to zero. (2) Use the onsite coefficient G=g+3 lambda, the harmonic bond -c q r, the Weyl identity [q,W_a]=a W_a, and the exact potential-potential derivative to expose the source and response degrees. (3) Check the symbolic identity, the degree gap, and the fixture ratio in independent SymPy and Fraction lanes. (4) Compile Lean R213 only for the rational polynomial identity, leading coefficient, and finite fixture arithmetic.
- **Finding:** Primary passes 19/19 and independent passes 17/17; the integrated lane passes 24/24 and Lean R213 passes. The exact response is cG a^5/2 - 2cG q a^4 + 3cG q^2 a^3 + (-2cG q^3 + 2c^2 r) a^2, while [q,W_a]=a W_a. For g=3/5, lambda=2/7, c=2/3, chi=7/4, G=51/35, the leading coefficient is 17/35 and the source-normalised ratio grows as (17/35) a^4. The declared linear-source first-passage coefficient route is therefore obstructed on this common-core class.
- **Decision reason:** This is an exact scoped route obstruction that removes one-sided critical energy normalisations with only linear source growth. It is not a no-go for analytic/Frechet, state-weighted, symmetric, or projected-Duhamel topologies, and it does not derive the actual Q3 factorial expansion.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing route checkpoint. It does not prove Q3 dynamics, a thermodynamic QFT, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production, or a Clay result.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Test a source-weighted analytic/Frechet or state-weighted topology whose declared growth absorbs the a^5 coefficient, then require a genuine two-orientation volume-uniform recurrence before any QFT interface promotion.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-001028](#exp-001028)

#### EXP-001030 — Source-weighted analytic envelope and explicit two-orientation branch factor

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-24T11:30:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Can a declared degree-five source weight absorb the onsite-dressed response while a symmetric two-orientation finite-step recurrence remains algebraically volume-independent?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Declare w_5(a)=(1+|a|)^5 and bound every degree-k coefficient of the exact common-core response by the coefficient sum times w_5 for k<=5. (2) Evaluate the coefficient envelope at five rational q,r points and six amplitudes in a primary lane and an independent Fraction lane. (3) Keep the forward and reverse branches separate, compute the exact factor 1+(C+2J) delta, and iterate the finite recurrence for six steps. (4) Compile Lean R214 only for rational coefficient, source-weight fixture, and two-orientation factor arithmetic.
- **Finding:** Primary passes 55/55 and independent passes 52/52; the integrated lane passes 27/27 and Lean R214 passes. The degree-five weight bounds the exact sampled response, the amplitude-10 weighted ratio is below the leading coefficient while the linear-source ratio is above it, and the symmetric two-orientation factor is 8/5 with six-step envelope (8/5)^6. This supplies a finite candidate interface for a source-weighted analytic/Frechet route.
- **Decision reason:** The test absorbs the specific degree-five onsite growth identified by EXP-001029 and prevents the reverse branch from being hidden in the recurrence constant. It is only a finite algebraic candidate: the weight is not a canonical Q3 seminorm and the actual all-bond recurrence remains open.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing finite candidate-envelope checkpoint. It does not prove Q3 dynamics, a thermodynamic QFT, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production, or a Clay result.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Define the degree-five weight as an actual common-core seminorm, prove the six-neighbour two-orientation Q3 recurrence uniformly in volume, and then prove exhaustion Cauchy before any QFT interface promotion.

#### EXP-001031 — Repeated onsite word degree escalation against fixed polynomial source weights

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-24T12:30:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does a fixed-degree polynomial source weight remain closed if an uncancelled repeated onsite potential-difference word appears in the Q3 first-passage history?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Form the exact prescribed word R_m(a)=partial_r(Delta_a(q,r)^m) at q=r=0 for word lengths m=1 through 5. (2) Use symbolic differentiation in the primary lane and an independent Fraction formula to check R_m=-m c(-G/4)^(m-1)a^(4m-3). (3) Compare the degree 4m-3 with the fixed degree-five source weight and record the m=3 degree-nine gap. (4) Compile Lean R215 only for the rational coefficient, degree, and fixed-weight-gap fixtures.
- **Finding:** Primary passes 22/22 and independent passes 21/21; the integrated lane passes 22/22 and Lean R215 passes. The prescribed word has exact degree 4m-3: m=2 gives degree five, while m=3 gives degree nine and outruns a fixed degree-five source weight by four powers of a. A cancellation theorem, truncation, or entire analytic source weight is therefore required before this word-level calculation can enter a first-passage recurrence.
- **Decision reason:** This is a precise boundary for the source-weight route: EXP-001030's degree-five weight absorbs one response but cannot be assumed to control arbitrary repeated onsite words. The result is not promoted to an actual Q3 obstruction because word incidence and cancellation in the full Duhamel expansion remain unproved.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing prescribed-word coefficient checkpoint. It does not prove that the Q3 dynamics contains the word, does not reject entire analytic/Frechet routes, and does not establish a thermodynamic QFT, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or TECT production.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Derive the actual Q3 word expansion and test cancellation or entire analytic source weights uniformly in word length and volume before any QFT interface promotion.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-001030](#exp-001030)

#### EXP-001033 — Primary QFT dynamics theorem applicability audit for quartic Q3

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-24T14:30:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **inconclusive**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Can a known infinite-volume anharmonic-oscillator QFT dynamics theorem close the Q3 all-shape split-history and common-alpha gate?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Compare the primary paper's model class, harmonic reference dynamics, perturbation representation, and locality estimate with the actual Q3 quartic onsite and quadratic bond terms. (2) Check whether the theorem's Weyl-measure and finite-moment hypotheses imply the Q3 quartic-force history bound; reject implication when the hypothesis is not established. (3) Separate the Weyl commutator/topological conclusion from the Q3 two-sided Gibbs split-history, static-tail, exhaustion, and common-alpha obligations. (4) Apply adversarial checks for model matching, quartic hypotheses, observable topology, QFT-to-TECT promotion, and the distinction between non-applicability and nonexistence.
- **Finding:** The cited QFT/mathematical-physics dynamics theorem is a relevant precedent but is not directly importable as proof of the Q3 all-shape split-history or common-alpha gate. It proves no obstruction; it fixes the missing Q3-specific estimate that must be supplied before promotion.
- **Decision reason:** The primary mathematical-physics results provide a precise locality and thermodynamic-dynamics template, but their controlled Weyl perturbation hypotheses and observable topology do not cover the actual quartic Q3 history gate. The correct next route is a Q3-specific quartic-force or energy-weighted estimate, not direct citation-based promotion.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing QFT applicability checkpoint. It does not prove or disprove Q3 infinite-volume dynamics, KMS, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production, or a Clay result.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Construct and independently review a Q3-specific quartic-force or energy-weighted local estimate that yields the two-orientation split-history tail and all-shape exhaustion Cauchy bound; retain the cited QFT theorem only as a comparison template until those hypotheses are proved.
- **Related explorations:** continues [EXP-001032](#exp-001032)

#### EXP-001034 — Primary W2 anharmonic-oscillator theorem applicability audit for quartic Q3

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-24T15:30:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **inconclusive**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does the W2/Lieb-Robinson theorem for interacting anharmonic oscillator lattices apply directly to the quartic Q3LOCK Hamiltonian and close its history/common-alpha gate?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Read the primary paper's Hamiltonian decomposition, perturbation hypotheses, W2 observable algebra, and Lieb-Robinson conclusion from the author-hosted arXiv record and full-text extraction. (2) Compare the Q3 onsite double-well and Q3-lock cross-bond polynomials with the theorem's subquadratic growth and Fourier-L1 derivative assumptions. (3) Separate the theorem's suitable-algebra locality conclusion from the active Q3 two-orientation Gibbs history, exhaustion, generator, and common-alpha KMS obligations. (4) Apply adversarial checks for growth, distributional Fourier transforms, cross-bond scope, conclusion scope, nonexistence overreach, and TECT promotion.
- **Finding:** The Amour-Lévy-Bruhl-Nourrigat interacting-anharmonic-oscillator result supplies a useful W2 and Lieb-Robinson template, but Q3 fails its stated perturbation hypotheses at the quartic growth and Fourier-distribution steps. The remaining proof must be Q3-specific and quartic-force/energy-weighted; no direct QFT import is justified.
- **Decision reason:** The W2/Lieb-Robinson theorem is a closer mathematical-QFT precedent than a harmonic-only theorem, but its explicit subquadratic onsite and Fourier-L1 perturbation assumptions exclude both the Q3 quartic double-well onsite term and the quartic Q3-lock cross-bond term. It cannot be promoted to the active history/common-alpha gate without a new quartic-force replacement theorem.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing primary-literature applicability checkpoint. It does not prove or disprove Q3 infinite-volume dynamics, KMS, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production, or a Clay result.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Prove a Q3-specific quartic-force or energy-weighted estimate on a declared common core, including the six-neighbour two-orientation history recurrence and a volume/source-uniform tail; only then compare its topology with W2 or OS/KMS constructions.

#### EXP-001038 — Actual finite-Q3 local Duhamel-word incidence and degree escalation

- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does a concrete local word built from the canonical Q3 onsite and one spatial-bond potential have a nonzero source coefficient of degree 4m-3?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Restrict the canonical onsite quartic and the three incident Q3 lock edges at species 000 with the other species set to zero, deriving G=g+3*lambda. (2) Form the exact shifted onsite difference and one selected spatial-bond difference from the canonical polynomial potentials. (3) Compute the ordered word with m-1 onsite factors and one bond factor, its m-position multiplication-word sum, and the exact source degree for m=1 through 6. (4) Run independent SymPy and sparse-polynomial Fraction lanes and compile Lean R220 for the rational degree and coefficient fixtures.
- **Finding:** The selected word is an actual local polynomial word of the canonical Q3 split. Its ordered coefficient is -c*(-G/4)^(m-1)*a^(4m-3), and the m-position sum is m times this nonzero coefficient for every tested word length. The degree-five/fixed-weight escalation is therefore an actual local-word witness, not only a prescribed abstract family.
- **Decision reason:** This closes the local incidence question while preserving the full-history firewall. The calculation is restricted to one species coordinate and one selected bond; it does not determine the signed complete Duhamel coefficient or a resummable source topology.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing actual local-word checkpoint. It does not prove the full Q3 dynamics, a thermodynamic QFT, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Insert the local word into a complete signed Duhamel expansion and prove cancellation or an entire/source-weighted resummation; otherwise record the first full-history obstruction before attempting common-alpha or QFT promotion.

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-24T22:30:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does the formal bi-entire coefficient topology admit a representation-independent weighted-l1 completion with dense finite polynomials, submultiplicative Cauchy product, and explicit radius-loss derivative bounds?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Represent the two-degree formal coefficient space as weighted l1 arrays on N^2 and use weighted convolution for multiplication. (2) Verify finite-support product submultiplicativity and formal field/source derivatives on a rational fixture. (3) Use a two-ratio geometric coefficient family to test exact weighted-norm tails and finite truncation density. (4) Run independent SymPy and Fraction lanes and compile Lean R224 for rational product, derivative, full-norm, and tail fixtures.
- **Finding:** At the formal coefficient level, weighted l1 arrays form a complete convolution algebra, finite-support truncations are dense, and strict radius loss gives derivative constants R/(R-R')^2 and S/(S-S')^2. The fixture has product norm 19/9 <= 34/9, derivative norms 4/3 and 11/9, constants 18 and 48, full geometric norm 7/6, and degree-three tail 1919/9261000 < 1/100. Primary passes 20/20, independent passes 20/20, integrated passes 37/37, and Lean R224 passes.
- **Decision reason:** This removes the purely formal completion ambiguity left by EXP-001041 and provides a candidate target topology for an actual Q3 common-core map. It is deliberately not promoted to an operator completion because no representation-independent CCR domain map, energy/state bridge, or history continuity estimate has been proved.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing formal completion checkpoint. It does not prove Q3 operator dynamics, a thermodynamic QFT, common alpha, KMS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Define an explicit candidate map from the actual Q3 common core into the formal weighted coefficient completion, then test whether the shifted-force/history map is continuous with volume and orientation control; record a no-go if the map cannot be made canonical.

(3) Apply the distance factor base^(-d) and compare the finite order-32 Poisson partial sum with exp(E) in two exact lanes. (4) Compile Lean R228 for B, E, the distance factor and the finite arithmetic fixture. (5) Keep the factorial first-passage expansion explicitly as an unresolved hypothesis.
- **Finding:** Under the declared factorial first-passage hypothesis, the EXP-001045 rate B=1382807/7168 gives E=4148421/896000 for two orientations, degree six, base two, and t=1/1000. At distance ten the conditional envelope is 2^(-10) exp(E), and the finite order-32 partial sum is below exp(E).
- **Decision reason:** This is a parameterized insertion of an actual Q3 weighted mixed rate into the existing first-passage bridge. It does not discharge the factorial response hypothesis, so the main Q3 history/common-alpha gate remains open.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing conditional rate insertion only; no actual Q3 locality or thermodynamic QFT conclusion is claimed.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Prove the factorial first-passage expansion for the actual Q3 commutator/Duhamel history with the lifted weighted rate, rather than assuming it.

<a id="exp-001047"></a>
#### EXP-001047 — Repeated cubic graph-factor transport boundary

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-25T01:00:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Do the two-sided one-factor Q3 graph bounds with A^(-3/4) control imply a uniform repeated product, or is an additional A-power transport theorem required?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Define the finite positive diagonal family A_n=diag(1,2^(4n),2^(8n)) and the raising shift S on three basis vectors. (2) Set Q_n=S A_n^(3/4) using the exact integer diagonal entries 1,2^(3n),2^(6n). (3) Compute both one-factor infinity norms and the repeated product norm with exact rational matrix arithmetic for n=1,2,3. (4) Reproduce the scale identities and inequalities in an independent lane and Lean R229.
- **Finding:** The one-factor norms are 1 and 2^(-3n), while the repeated target norm is 2^(3n)=8^n. Separate one-factor A^(-3/4) bounds therefore do not yield a volume- or history-uniform repeated-factor bound.
- **Decision reason:** This is a new linkage after EXP-001045/1046: it isolates repeated A-power composition, rather than the already-recorded one-site-to-mixed marginal failure or the prescribed polynomial-word degree escalation.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing finite operator inference boundary. It rejects only the naive repeated-factor inference and does not reject stronger Q3-specific transport, analytic/Frechet, or cancellation routes.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Prove a Q3-specific higher-energy/A-power transport or an analytic/Frechet history composition estimate, then revisit the actual two-orientation first-passage recurrence.
- **Related explorations:** -
- **Formal authorities:** -
- **Located evidence:** [`strategy/pre-a-cp1-st8-q3lock-repeated-factor-transport-boundary-manifest.json`](../strategy/pre-a-cp1-st8-q3lock-repeated-factor-transport-boundary-manifest.json) (operator_witness); [`strategy/pre-a-cp1-st8-q3lock-repeated-factor-transport-boundary-certificate-260824.md`](../strategy/pre-a-cp1-st8-q3lock-repeated-factor-transport-boundary-certificate-260824.md) (Finding); [`codes/foundations/pre_a_cp1_st8_q3lock_repeated_factor_transport_boundary.py`](../codes/foundations/pre_a_cp1_st8_q3lock_repeated_factor_transport_boundary.py) (run); [`codes/foundations/pre_a_cp1_st8_q3lock_repeated_factor_transport_boundary_independent.py`](../codes/foundations/pre_a_cp1_st8_q3lock_repeated_factor_transport_boundary_independent.py) (run); [`codes/foundations/pre_a_cp1_st8_q3lock_repeated_factor_transport_boundary_verify.py`](../codes/foundations/pre_a_cp1_st8_q3lock_repeated_factor_transport_boundary_verify.py) (main); [`verification/lean/Tect/R229.lean`](../verification/lean/Tect/R229.lean) (repeated_product_fixture)

<a id="exp-001048"></a>
#### EXP-001048 — Conditional central-context Q3 history composition

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-25T01:30:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha), [PA-ROUND1-EVIDENCE-ROLE-AND-MINIMUM-MANIFEST-FREEZE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-round1-evidence-role-and-minimum-manifest-freeze); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** If every actual Q3 source difference has all four A^(a) D A^(-b) contexts at the one-step rate B, does the central insertion identity give a uniform B^n word bound and the corresponding factorial first-passage envelope?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Recompute the EXP-001045 onsite, edge and bond source polynomials in an independent primary and Fraction lane to obtain B=1382807/7168 from upstream inputs. (2) Declare the four common-core contexts M_(a,b)(D)=||A^a D A^(-b)|| for a,b in {0,3/4} as an explicit hypothesis rather than inheriting them from one-sided graph bounds. (3) Check A^a D_1...D_n A^(-b)=(A^a D_1 A^(-s))(A^s D_2 A^(-s))...(A^s D_n A^(-b)) on an exact diagonal finite fixture for all four contexts and word lengths one through four. (4) Insert the conditional B^n word bound into the separate two-orientation degree-six factorial first-passage EGF and compile Lean R230 for the group insertion and rational fixtures.
- **Finding:** Under the explicit four-context central hypothesis, the common-core insertion is exact and gives a B^n word bound; the recomputed EXP-001045 rate yields a conditional first-passage exponent eta=4148421/896000 for the declared fixture. The central-context hypothesis and the factorial Q3 recurrence are not proved.
- **Decision reason:** This is a non-duplicative continuation after EXP-001047: it turns the repeated-factor boundary into an explicit sufficient central-context theorem for the actual Q3 source rate, while preserving the missing operator hypothesis as an open gate.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing conditional finite common-core composition checkpoint. It does not establish the four central Q3 contexts, actual repeated histories, first-passage decay, exhaustion Cauchy convergence, common alpha, KMS/OS reconstruction, a GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or the TECT production owner.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Prove the four central contexts for the actual Q3 common core with volume, source and orientation control, or construct an exact obstruction; only then attempt the actual factorial two-orientation first-passage recurrence.

<a id="exp-001049"></a>
#### EXP-001049 — One-sided Q3 graph bounds do not imply central A-context control

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-25T02:00:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ENERGY-WEIGHTED-COMMUTATOR-GEVREY-LR-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-energy-weighted-commutator-gevrey-lr-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Do the two one-sided A^(-3/4) graph bounds used by the Q3 source lift imply the central conjugation bound ||A^(3/4) D A^(-3/4)|| needed by the EXP-001048 composition theorem?
- **Finite checks:** (1) Reuse the exact positive diagonal energy family A_n=diag(1,2^(4n),2^(8n)) and raising shift S, but set D_n=S A_n^(3/4) so the target is a single central conjugation context. (2) Compute ||D_n A_n^(-3/4)||, ||A_n^(-3/4)D_n||, ||A_n^(3/4)D_n A_n^(-3/4)|| and ||D_n|| exactly for n=1,2,3 in primary SymPy and independent Fraction lanes. (3) Compile Lean R231 for the exact 2^3, 2^6, 2^12 and 2^18 fixtures and preserve the finite-operator/Q3 scope firewall.
- **Finding:** The one-sided norms are 1 and 2^(-3n), while the single central context norm is 2^(6n)=64^n and the ordinary factor norm is 2^(3n). Therefore the one-sided graph estimates cannot by themselves imply the central A^(3/4) D A^(-3/4) context required by EXP-001048. This rejects an inference rule only; it does not identify the witness with an actual Q3 source difference or prove the actual Q3 central context unbounded.
- **Decision reason:** This is the direct next test after EXP-001048: it isolates the missing single-factor central context rather than repeating the prior repeated-product target. The result routes the proof toward a product-level analytic/Frechet, heat-strip or state-weighted estimate.
- **Boundary:** T0 claim-nonbearing finite central-context inference boundary. It does not establish a Q3 no-go or a thermodynamic QFT.
- **Next / revisit condition:** Replace the unavailable central context by a product-level analytic/Frechet, heat/strip-loss or state-weighted estimate, retaining the spatial weight and both orientations, and test its first-passage consequence.

#### EXP-001050 — Actual Q3 source polynomial coefficient-product envelope

- **Review metadata:** reviewed 2026-08-24; recorded 2026-08-25T02:30:00Z; `contemporaneous`; verdict **advanced**.
- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ENERGY-WEIGHTED-COMMUTATOR-GEVREY-LR-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-energy-weighted-commutator-gevrey-lr-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha); task `T-054`.

(2) Construct the source-at-neighbor relabelled polynomial with swapped radii (8,4,1/4) and verify the same exact norm in independent SymPy and Fraction lanes. (3) Expand P^n and its relabelled counterpart for n=1,2,3,4 and check the formal Cauchy-product bounds ||P^n||<=B^n, then compile Lean R232 for the exact rate and first-passage exponent fixtures.

- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ENERGY-WEIGHTED-COMMUTATOR-GEVREY-LR-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-energy-weighted-commutator-gevrey-lr-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha); task `T-054`.

- **Structured scope:** claim [C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE](../claims/C6-SPACETIME-SIGNATURE/claim.md); gate [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ENERGY-WEIGHTED-COMMUTATOR-GEVREY-LR-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-energy-weighted-commutator-gevrey-lr-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-FIRST-PASSAGE-BACKBONE-REAL-TIME-PRODUCT-AND-ENERGY-TAIL-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-first-passage-backbone-real-time-product-and-energy-tail-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-ALL-BOND-UNITARY-TROTTER-GRAPH-LIPSCHITZ-AND-COMMON-ALPHA-CLOSURE](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-all-bond-unitary-trotter-graph-lipschitz-and-common-alpha-closure), [PA-CP1-ST8-Q3LOCK-LOCAL-STRICT-ALL-EXHAUSTION-TWO-ORIENTATION-HISTORY-COMMON-ALPHA](../claims/GATES.md#pa-cp1-st8-q3lock-local-strict-all-exhaustion-two-orientation-history-common-alpha); task `T-054`.
- **Question:** Does the actual Q3 source admit a finite ordinary multiplication-operator norm on an unbounded field line, or must the QFT route use an energy-weighted/domain seminorm?

(2) Compute the slice degree, factorization, leading coefficient, positive cubic ratio limit, and exact values at q=4,8,16,32,64 in primary SymPy and independent Fraction lanes. (3) Compile Lean R234 for the exact leading coefficient, growth values, coefficient-rate boundary and scope firewall, while keeping the energy-weighted A(q)=1+q^4 route explicitly conditional.
- **Finding:** The exact slice is P_0(q)=(51/140)q^3-(153/1120)q^2+(2291/2240)q-4531/35840, with positive leading coefficient and ratio limit 51/140.
